text: The Stuhlmannbrunnen, a fountain in Hamburg, Germany, is located in the Republic Square of the Altona district and was built in 1900. It was designed by Paul Türpe and is a cultural heritage.

Jin'ao Yuyu Bridge, originally named Jinhai Bridge, also known as Yuhe Bridge, commonly known as Beihai Bridge, is located between Beihai Park in Xicheng District, Beijing and Zhongnanhai. The bridge is Wenjin Street.

tail.text: between Beihai Park in Xicheng District, Beijing and Zhongnanhai

text: The Qiqihar Fourth Hospital, now known as the Qiqihar Union Hospital, is located at No. 28, Yumin 1st Street, Jianhua District. In 2007, the municipal office attracted investment, with a total investment of 16 million yuan from foreign merchants, and the newly built Qiqihar Union Hospital. However, this hospital has no relation with the Beijing Union Hospital.

Chen Shili Bridge, officially known as Ruan Wen Zhui-Chen Shili Bridge, is a bridge located in Da Nang, Vietnam, spanning the Han River. This bridge replaced two old bridges named after Ruan Wen Zhui and Chen Shili.

Wenxiakou Reservoir is located in Zhongxiang City, Hubei Province, China. It is a large  type reservoir with the main functions of irrigation and flood control, and also has functions such as power generation and aquaculture. In 2008, it was listed as a national water conservancy scenic spot by the Ministry of Water Resources under the name of "Zhongxiang Wenxia Lake Water Conservancy Scenic Area".

tail.text: Zhongxiang Wenxia Lake Water Conservancy Scenic Area

text: The Wordless Stele, also known as the Monument, is located on the east side of the Tang Qian Mausoleum in Qian County, Shaanxi. It was erected by the Wu Zhou Emperor Wu Zetian and corresponds to the Shu Sheng Ji Stele of Tang Gaozong Li Zhi on the west side. The Wordless Stele is carved from a single piece of stone, weighing 98.8 tons, and is a giant among the tombstones of all ages in China.

Kogen-ji is a temple of the Rinzai sect, Yuanjue Temple faction, located in Gyoda City, Saitama Prefecture, Japan. Its mountain name is Tenshinzan, and the main deity worshipped is Amitabha Tathagata.

The Old Baeza Cathedral (Spanish: Catedral de Baeza) is a Roman Catholic church in the city of Baeza in the autonomous region of Andalusia in southern Spain. The church was once the cathedral of the Baeza diocese. The church is also listed as a World Heritage Site.

Penghu Airport, is a military-civilian airport located in Aimen Village, Huxi Township, Penghu County, Taiwan. It is the main external airport of Penghu County, formerly known as "Magong Airport". The civilian part is managed and operated by the Magong Aviation Station of the Civil Aviation Administration of the Ministry of Transport; the military part is the Air Force Magong Base.

Beijing Amusement Park, located at No. 19, Zuo'anmen Inner Street, Dongcheng District, Beijing (originally belonged to Chongwen District, which merged with Dongcheng District in 2010 to form the new Dongcheng District), is a large amusement park. It was closed in 2010 and reopened on September 24, 2021, under the name of Longtan Zhonghu Park, becoming a free park.

Xiajiasi Reservoir, located in Huangpi District, Wuhan City, Hubei Province, China, is a large  type reservoir with the main functions of irrigation and flood prevention, and also considers tourism, aquaculture, power generation and other functions. Because it is located in the territory of Mulan Township on the east side of Mulan Mountain, it is also called Mulan Lake. In 2007, it was approved by the Ministry of Water Resources as the seventh batch of national water conservancy scenic spots.

tail.text: located in the territory of Mulan Township on the east side of Mulan Mountain

text: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Calbayog (Latin: Dioecesis Calbayoganus, Tagalog: Diyosesis ng Calbayog) is a diocese of the Roman Catholic Church in the Philippines, belonging to the Archdiocese of Palo. Its jurisdiction includes the province of Western Samar. It was elevated to a diocese on April 12, 1910. In 2006, it had 668,000 parishioners, 27 parishes, and 65 priests. The current bishop is Isabella Avarquez. The cathedral is the Cathedral of Saints Peter and Paul, located in the capital of Western Samar, Calbayog.

head.text: The Roman Catholic Diocese of Calbayog
The Roman Catholic Diocese of Calbayog

text: The Berlin Radio Tower (German: Berliner Funkturm) is a former broadcasting tower in Berlin. It was built between 1924 and 1926, designed by architect Heinrich Straumer, and was declared completed on September 3, 1926, at the third Great German Radio Exhibition. It is located in Charlottenburg-Wilmersdorf in the center of Berlin. This tower, nicknamed "Skinny Guy" (der lange Lulatsch), is one of the most famous attractions in Berlin. Although it is no longer used for broadcasting purposes, it is still a protected monument.

Lì Miào Bridge, also translated as Dì Miào Bridge, is a cable-stayed bridge in the Mekong Delta region of Vietnam. The bridge connects Meiqiu City in Qianjiang Province and Zhoucheng County in Bingzhan Province.

The Cal Farley Farm, established by Cal Farley, the father of American foster care, in 1939. It is located in the Taskosa area of Texas. It provides family-style foster care for boys and is known as the Boys Farm. Cal Farley also established a Girls Town 45 miles west of Lubbock at Whiteface.

Jilin Ertaizi Airport , also known as Jilin Airport, is an airport in Jilin City, Jilin Province, China. Jilin Airport used to be a military-civilian airport, but it stopped civil aviation services on September 20, 2005.
Wewak Airport, also known as Boram Airport, is an airport located in Wewak, Papua New Guinea. IATA code: WWK; ICAO code: AYWK.
The Barris Bridge , also known as the New Bridge , is a bridge in Perigueux, Dordogne, Nouvelle-Aquitaine, France.
Otani Temple is a Shingon sect temple of the Toyama school in Nagaokakyo City, Kyoto Prefecture. It is known to people as the Temple of Peony.

The Kaohsiung Municipal International Swimming Pool, formerly known as the Kaohsiung Municipal International Standard Swimming Pool, is located at No. 1, Lane 94, Zhongzheng 1st Road, Lingya District, Kaohsiung City, adjacent to Zhongzheng Sports Field and Zhongzheng Martial Arts Hall. It was completed in April 1996 and has a seating capacity of 3000 people. The swimming pool is a venue for swimming, diving, and water ballet competitions. During the 2009 World Games, it was the competition venue for fin swimming and water rescue events.

tail.text: Kaohsiung Municipal International Standard Swimming Pool

text: The Chini Mosque is a mosque in Soidpur city, Nilphamari district, Rangpur division, Bangladesh. This mosque is also known as the Glass Mosque. The construction of the mosque began in 1863, built by Haji Bakar Ali Ahmed, and was completed within a year.

Velenje Castle (Slovenian: Velenjski grad) is a well-preserved castle located in the Slovenian city of Velenje. The castle is now used as an art and culture museum. Velenje Castle was mentioned as early as 1270.

The Changhua County Art Museum, also known as Changhua Art Museum, is located at No. 3, Guashan Road, Changhua City, Changhua County, Taiwan. It is the seventh public art museum in Taiwan and one of the professional venues under the Changhua County Cultural Bureau.

The Shanghai No.1 Intermediate People's Court (also known as: Shanghai First Intermediate Court, Shanghai Intermediate Court, Hu First Intermediate Court; official document code: Hu First Intermediate) is an intermediate people's court in Shanghai, People's Republic of China, located at No. 1200 Hongqiao Road, Changning District, Shanghai.

Lubart's Castle, also known as Lutsk Castle or Upper Castle, is a castle located in the Ukrainian city of Lutsk, its history can be traced back to the mid-14th century. The castle is one of the most famous landmarks in Lutsk and appears in the design of the 200 Ukrainian hryvnia banknote.

The Fourth Public Retail Market of Taitung City is a traditional market located in Taitung City, Taitung County, Taiwan. Due to its location near Kaifeng Street in Taitung City, it is also known as Kaifeng Market. It is managed by the Retail Market Management Office of Taitung City Hall and was once the first government-operated twilight market in Taiwan.

head.text: The Fourth Public Retail Market of Taitung City
The Fourth Public Retail Market of Taitung City

text: Risshaku-ji is a Tendai Buddhist temple located in Yamagata City, Yamagata Prefecture, Japan. It is also known by the name Yamadera.

The Plato Decorative Art Museum, also known as the Italian Pavilion, is a foreigner's pavilion located in Yamamoto-dori, Kitano-cho, Chuo-ku, Kobe, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. It was formerly known as the old Aboi Mansion. It is also part of the "Yamamoto-dori, Kitano-cho", an important traditional building group preservation area.
The Aalborg Museum of Modern Art (Danish: KUNSTEN Museum of Modern Art i Aalborg, or KUNSTEN) is a museum located in Aalborg, North Jutland, Denmark.

head.text: The Aalborg Museum of Modern Art

tail.text: KUNSTEN Museum of Modern Art i Aalborg

head.text: The Aalborg Museum of Modern Art

text: Castello Doria, also known as Castello di Vernazza, is a defensive building in Vernazza, Cinque Terre region, La Spezia province, located on a cliff seventy meters above the sea.

The National Sports Training Center  is the training base for the national sports team of the Republic of China . It is an administrative corporation under the jurisdiction of the Ministry of Education. When it was put into use in 1976, it was called the "Zuoying Sports Training Center" .

Barclay Memorial Park, also known as Barclay Park, is Park No. 18, named in memory of the British pastor Barclay. It is located in Chongming Village, East District, Tainan City, and the Tainan Cultural Center is across the park.

Changmen Battery (called Fort Blanc, meaning White Castle, by the French fleet during the Sino-French War), also known as Dian Guang Mountain Battery, is located on Dian Guang Mountain in Changmen Village, Guantou Town, Lianjiang County, Fujian Province. This place is on the north bank of the Minjiang River estuary, flanked by Jinpai Mountain on the south bank, guarding the narrowest part of the Minjiang River estuary. It is currently the oldest and largest existing battery in China, built during the Chongzhen period of the Ming Dynasty.

tail.text: Chongzhen period of the Ming Dynasty

text: The Takashima Observation Deck, also translated as the Korkeasaari Observation Deck, is located in the Helsinki Zoo on Takashima in Helsinki, Finland. It was built in 2002 and was designed and constructed by architect Veer Hara.

Hefei Grand Theater Station, a subway station in Hefei City, Anhui Province, China, with the project station names Swan Lake Road Station and Grand Theater Station, is located at the intersection of Huaining Road and Swan Lake Road, and is a station of Hefei Rail Transit Line 3.

tail.text: intersection of Huaining Road and Swan Lake Road

text: Ohrid St. Paul the Apostle Airport, commonly known as Ohrid Airport, is a civil airport in the southwestern city of Ohrid, North Macedonia, and is the only civil airport in North Macedonia, located 9 kilometers northwest of Ohrid.

head.text: Ohrid St. Paul the Apostle Airport
Ohrid St. Paul the Apostle Airport

text: Independence Square is a square in Minsk, the capital of Belarus, and is also one of the landmarks on Independence Avenue. The Supreme Soviet of Belarus and the Minsk City Hall are located in Independence Square. During the Soviet era, the square was named Lenin Square. Now, Independence Square is one of the largest squares in Europe.

The Guanzhong Folk Art Museum is a folk museum located in Chang'an District, Xi'an City, Shaanxi Province. The museum covers an area of 493.88 acres and has a planned building area of 108,000 square meters, which was funded and built by Wang Yongchao. The museum has relocated more than 40 Ming and Qing ancient folk houses from different places in the Guanzhong area to the museum, and at the same time, more than 8600 horse stakes from various dynasties have been moved here.

The Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes is a place of pilgrimage for the Catholic Church to pay homage to Our Lady of Lourdes, located in Lourdes, France. It includes the Massabielle Grotto, the nearby spring flowing with Lourdes holy water, the office of the Lourdes Medical Bureau, and several churches and papal basilicas such as the Basilica of the Immaculate Conception, the Basilica of Our Lady of the Rosary, and the Basilica of St. Pius X. It covers an area of 51 hectares and includes 22 different places of worship. The sanctuary has six official languages: French, English, Italian, Spanish, Dutch, and German.

head.text: The Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes
The Sanctuary of Our Lady of Lourdes

text: Djerdap National Park is a national park in Serbia, covering the area from the right bank of the Danube River from Golubac Fortress to Novi Sad. This national park was established in 1974, with an area of 63,786.5 ha (157,620 acres).

Chongqing Garden Expo Park is a city park located in the Longjing Lake area of Liangjiang New District in Chongqing City, with the address of No.1 Longjing Road, Yuanyang Street, Yubei District. The park covers an area of 3300 mu, including a water area of 800 mu. It is a landmark garden public facility in Chongqing with a total investment of 1.48 billion yuan.

The campus of Zhangshu National Primary School is located at No. 2, Lane 141, Zhangshu 1st Road, Xizhi District, and belongs to the Zhangshu business district. It is bordered by the Keelung River to the north and Haotian Ridge to the east, covering an area of 20,970 square meters.

head.text: The campus of Zhangshu National Primary School
The campus of Zhangshu National Primary School

text: Laolongtou Reservoir, a small reservoir located in Chengshan Village and Sandao River in Dengta Town, Xi'an District, Liaoyuan City, Jilin Province, China, controls a catchment area of 47.43 square kilometers and has a total storage capacity of 9.64 million cubic meters. It is one of the sources of drinking water for Liaoyuan City.

Krasinski Square is a square located in the center of Warsaw, the capital of Poland. This square is famous for its numerous historical buildings. The history of the square dates back to the late 18th century.

Peacock Island Palace  is a palace building on the Havel River in Berlin, Germany, with a romantic style exterior. This building was built in 1797 during the reign of Frederick William II. Now this palace is a museum.

The Seventh Grandfather Mansion, also known as the Fu Xiang Grandfather Mansion, is located in Harlamodu Town, Qian Guo County, Jilin Province, China. It is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit, classified as an ancient building, and was announced on May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by the Qian Guo County Cultural Management Office. The historical era of the Seventh Grandfather Mansion is the Qing Dynasty.

The Royal Cinque Ports Golf Club is an 18-hole links golf course located in Deal, Kent, in the southeast of England, UK. The course was established in 1892 and hosted the British Open Golf Championship twice in 1909 and 1920.

The Kuala Lumpur International Airport Station  is located at the Kuala Lumpur International Airport in Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia, and was opened for operation on June 10, 2002, along with the Kuala Lumpur Airport Express .

The Ikejima Bridge is a bridge located in the northwest of Miyakojima City, Okinawa Prefecture. The Ikejima Bridge is 1,425 meters long and connects Miyakojima and Ikejima. The bridge was opened to traffic in February 1992, and before the completion of the Kojima Bridge in March 1995, it was the longest bridge in Okinawa Prefecture.

Kasungu National Park is a national park in the western part of Malawi, located in the western part of Kasungu, about 175 kilometers from the capital of Malawi, Lilongwe. The national park extends to the border of Zambia. Kasungu National Park was established in 1970, with a protected area of 2,316 square kilometers. It is the second largest national park in Malawi, with an average altitude of over 1,000 meters.

The Cangshan Stone Buddha Hall, located in Cangshan, Baoding City, Hebei Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit in Fuping County, Baoding City. The type is a stone cave temple, and the announcement time is July 23, 1982. The historical era of the Cangshan Stone Buddha Hall is the Ming Dynasty.

Shandong International Financial Center is a skyscraper under construction in Jinan, Shandong Province, China. The construction started in 2018 and topped out in 2022. The building is 428 meters high and has 88 floors. It is expected to become the tallest building in Jinan after its completion in 2023.

The Garabit Viaduct  is a railway viaduct located in the Cantal department near Ruynes-en-Margeride, France, spanning the Truyère river. The bridge is located in the Central Massif region of France. The viaduct was designed by Gustave Eiffel and built between 1882 and 1884, with Maurice Koechlin serving as the structural engineer. It was opened in 1885. The bridge is 565 meters  long, with a main span of 165 meters .

Stallbron  is an arch bridge located in the old town center of Stockholm, the capital of Sweden. Stallbron is one of the oldest bridges in Stockholm's history, originally built in the 18th century. The current Stallbron is a single-arch steel bridge, completed in 1904.

Xishan Temple, is a Northern Emperor Temple located in Guangzhou, Guangdong, at the first Jin grass field in the west of the city, which was established in the Ming Dynasty. It once joined other local temples to establish a charity hall, which no longer exists today.

The Hallwyl Museum  is a museum in Sweden, located in the center of Stockholm. The building of the Hallwyl Museum was built from 1893 to 1898, once belonged to the Count and Countess of Hallwyl, but was donated to the Swedish government in 1920. The museum opened in 1938.

The Wawel Royal Castle is a medieval castle located in Wawel, Poland. This castle was built by Casimir III the Great from 1357 to 1370, originally as a defensive fortification. During World War II, the castle was severely damaged and has been under reconstruction since 1964.

Grodno Castle, also known as Grodno Castle, is a castle in Poland, located in the south of Poland. Grodno Castle was built in 1193 by Duke Bolesław. The castle was once part of the defensive line between the Duchy of Jawor and the Kingdom of Bohemia.

Fengshan Theater, located in Fengshan Town, Chengde City, Hebei Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relics protection unit in Fengning Manchu Autonomous County of Chengde City. The type is ancient architecture, and the announcement time is July 23, 1982. The historical era of Fengshan Theater is the Qing Dynasty.

The Panemune Castle is a castle building in Lithuania, located on the right bank of the Nemunas River in the Jurbarkas district. This castle was built in the early 17th century, and its construction purpose was not for military purposes but for noble residences. This castle is also one of the most beautiful Renaissance buildings in Lithuania.

Hengfeng Road Overpass is a cable-stayed bridge spanning the Shanghai-Nanjing Railway in Jing'an District, Shanghai, People's Republic of China. It is also the country's first prestressed concrete single-tower single-cable harp-style cable-stayed bridge. It is located west of Shanghai Railway Station. The total length is 630 meters. The bridge runs from north to south, connecting Hengfeng North Road in the north and Hengfeng Road in the south. It was completed and opened to traffic on September 30, 1987.

The Red Church is a former Protestant church in Olomouc, Czech Republic. This church was built by German architect Max Löwe from 1901 to 1902 for the local German-speaking Bohemians, Moravians, and Silesians of the German Evangelical Church. After the Second World War, the Germans were expelled, and the church was handed over to the Czech Protestants. In 1959, it was given to the university library.

The Church of Water is a small chapel located in the Hoshino TOMAMU Resort on a mountain in Shimukappu Village, Yufutsu District, in the center of Hokkaido, Japan. It was designed by architect Tadao Ando in 1985, built with fair-faced concrete, and completed in 1988. Together with the "Church of Wind" and the "Church of Light", they are collectively referred to as "Tadao Ando's Trilogy of Churches".

The Salvation Church is an ancient Christian church in Wuhan, China, which combines Chinese and Western styles. The Salvation Church is located on Han Zheng Street in Qiaokou District, adjacent to the earliest Western hospital in Wuhan, the Universal Love Hospital. It was built by the British Methodist missionary Guo Xiuli in 1867, rebuilt in 1931, with upturned eaves and can accommodate nearly a thousand people. It is the central church of the Methodist Church. In 1958, a joint worship was implemented, and the Salvation Church was able to continue to be preserved until the outbreak of the Cultural Revolution in 1966. Worship was resumed in the 1980s. It is listed as an excellent historical building in Wuhan.

The most important Renaissance building in Mainz is the Electoral Palace, which is a representative building of the so-called "German Renaissance" in its later period. Other Renaissance buildings include today's Gutenberg Museum and the French Research Institute. The "Market Fountain" is the most luxurious Renaissance fountain in Germany. Another building from the transition period between the Renaissance and Baroque is the Old University Main Building, which was built in 1615. For centuries, it has been the tallest civil building in Mainz.

Mariinsky Park is a park in the center of Kiev, the capital of Ukraine, located at the intersection of Constitution Square, Grushevsky Street, and Park Road. The park has a history of about 130 years.

tail.text: has a history of about 130 years
the center of Kiev, the capital of Ukraine

text: Chongzhen Church is the oldest existing Christian church in Wuhan, China. Chongzhen Church is located at No. 44, Gejiaying, Wuchang District, and was built by Yang Gefei, a missionary from the London Missionary Society, in 1864. It was the first Christian church in the provincial capital Wuchang. It is in Gothic style, with pointed arch windows, and can accommodate 200 people. In 1958, it implemented joint worship, and the staff of Gejiaying Chongzhen Church was incorporated into Hanyangmen Life Church, and the house was converted into a paper factory warehouse. Worship was resumed in November 2000. In 2005, it was listed as the second batch of excellent historical buildings in Wuhan.

Tiger Stadium, located in Detroit, Michigan, USA, was the stadium used by the Major League team Detroit Tigers from 1912 to 1999. The NFL team Detroit Lions also used this stadium as their home field from 1938 to 1974. On September 27, 1999, the Tigers held their last game here. The stadium was abandoned for renovation and announced to be abandoned, and it began to be demolished in 2008 and ended in 2009. In 2018, the old site of the stadium was used to develop youth sports.

tail.text: the stadium used by the Major League team Detroit Tigers from 1912 to 1999

text: The Starlight Bridge is a pedestrian-only bridge located in Xizhi District, New Taipei City. It spans the Keelung River, with a total length of 270 meters and a width of 8.6 to 9.1 meters. It connects the first section of Xiangzhang Road and the Jiangzhang Pumping Station in New Taipei City, and was completed on October 31, 2014.

The "Tokyo Grand Mosque Foundation" was established by the then Director of the Religious Affairs Bureau and the Turkish Cultural Center of the Religious Affairs Bureau in 1997. So far , 12 imams have served in this mosque.

tail.text: Director of the Religious Affairs Bureau

text: Trakai Castle is a castle in Lithuania, located in the town of Trakai in the Ukmerge district of central Lithuania. The castle overlooks Lake Trakai and was built in the 16th century in the Renaissance style. Since 1990, the castle has been undergoing reconstruction.
Kasperk Castle is a medieval castle in the southwest of Bohemia . This castle is the highest-ranking royal castle in Bohemia, located on a peak of 886 meters . Kasperk Castle was built in 1356.
The Europa-Center is a complex located at Breitscheidplatz in Berlin, Germany, which includes a shopping center and a building constructed from 1963 to 1965, with a height of 86 meters .

The Lashi Catholic Church, located in Lashi Village, Huangtang Town, Zijin County, Heyuan City, Guangdong Province, China, is a Catholic church dedicated to the Blessed Mother of the Forward Faith. Built in 1916, it was originally a wooden structure, but was damaged and neglected during the Cultural Revolution. It was rebuilt in 2010 and reopened on May 24, 2011, the day of the Patron Saint's Feast.

Vasabron (The Vasa Bridge) is a bridge in Stockholm, the capital of Sweden, connecting Norrmalm and Stockholm's Old Town. The bridge is named after the Swedish King Gustav Vasa. The construction of the Vasa Bridge began in 1872 and was completed six years later.

The Shahuang Weihe Bridge is a highway bridge located in Shahuang Village, Weinan City, Shaanxi Province, People's Republic of China. It is part of the National Highway G108. The bridge is 2294 meters long and construction began on October 31, 1991. It was completed in June 1994 and was the longest bridge in Shaanxi Province at the time of its completion. The Shahuang Weihe Bridge is the second bridge to span the Weihe River in Weinan City after the Shangzhangdu Weihe Bridge.

Sanxia Square is located in the downtown of Shapingba District, Chongqing, China, in the shape of a cross. It started construction in 1997 and is divided into four parts: Green Art Square, Commercial Culture Street, Celebrity Sculpture Garden, and Sanxia Landscape.

The Golden Roof  is a landmark in Innsbruck, Austria, built by Holy Roman Emperor Maximilian I in 1500, decorated with 2657 gilded copper tiles. The reliefs on the balcony depict coats of arms, symbols, and other characters from his life.

Gorlitzer Park is a park in Berlin, the capital of Germany, located in Kreuzberg. The northwest corner of the park is Gorlitzer Station. The park was established in the 1980s, and before that, it was a train station. It is also a hotspot for buying marijuana.

The Ishigaki Agricultural Association Rice Mill Granary, located in Wan'an Village, Ishigaki District, Taichung City, Taiwan, was specially equipped with earthquake resistance for the 1935 Hsinchu-Taichung earthquake. It was built in 1942 and survived the 1999 921 earthquake. It is now listed as a historical building.

head.text: The Ishigaki Agricultural Association Rice Mill Granary
The Ishigaki Agricultural Association Rice Mill Granary

text: The Sofia Synagogue is the largest synagogue in Southeast Europe, and one of the two synagogues in Bulgaria , and it is the third largest synagogue in Europe. The Sofia Synagogue began to be built in 1903 and was completed in 1909.
Tokyo Sankei Building is a skyscraper located in Otemachi, Chiyoda Ward, Tokyo, and its current owner is Sankei Building Co., Ltd.

The Taichung Longjing Solar Power Plant is located in Longjing District, Taichung City, Taiwan, and is a ground-based solar power plant built by Taiwan Power Company. This power plant is one of the sub-projects in the "First Phase of Solar Power Plan" promoted by Taiwan Power Company.

The Miyagi Prefecture Art Museum is a Miyagi Prefecture public art museum located in Kawauchi Motozukura, Aoba Ward, Sendai City, Miyagi Prefecture, Japan. The designer of the main museum is Kunio Maekawa. The annex on the west side of the main museum is the Sato Tadayoshi Memorial Museum, which displays the works of Sato Tadayoshi. The main museum opened in 1981, and the Sato Tadayoshi Memorial Museum opened in 1990.
Pipa Mountain Park is an urban park located on Zhongshan Second Road in Yuzhong District, Chongqing City. The mountain is 345 meters high, which is the highest point in Yuzhong District.

The New Castle is a castle located in the Slovak town of Banska Stiavnica. This castle is situated on a small hill in the southern part of the city center of Banska Stiavnica, with an altitude of 630 meters, which is also the highest point in the city center. Now this castle is a museum.

Asen's Fortress is a medieval fortress in the Rhodope Mountains of Bulgaria, located 2 to 3 kilometers  south of Asenovgrad, with an altitude of 279 meters . The best preserved part of the fortress is the Church of the Virgin Mary.

The Qing Shui Pu Bridge is a bridge over the Yong River in Ningbo City, Zhejiang Province, China. It carries the Ningbo Ring Expressway and is a joint tower split beam double tower four cable-stayed bridge. The main tower of the bridge is 141.5 meters high, the main span is 468 meters, and the width is 56.7 meters. It has eight lanes in both directions. Construction began on November 8, 2007, the main bridge was completed on December 15, 2010, and it was opened to traffic on December 28, 2011. At the time of its completion, it was the largest joint tower split beam cable-stayed bridge in the world.

Panzhihua Bao'anying Airport  is located in the southeastern part of Panzhihua City, Sichuan Province, People's Republic of China, on the top of the mountain where Yijiang Town in the East District and Jinjiang Town in Renhe District meet. The runway is 1976 meters above sea level, with a relative height difference of about one kilometer from the Jinsha River at the foot of the mountain. The air distance is 537 kilometers from Chengdu, 193 kilometers from Kunming, 173 kilometers from Dali, 155 kilometers from Lijiang, and 165 kilometers from Xichang. The flight area level is 4C, the runway length is 2800 meters, and there are 4 apron positions, which can take off and land Boeing 737, Airbus A320 and other models.

Huizhou Jinshan Bridge, located in Huicheng District, Huizhou City, Guangdong Province, China, is a highway bridge spanning the Xinkai River and the West Branch River. The construction of the bridge started on April 13, 2007. On July 13, 2009, the Jinshan Bridge, which had been under construction for more than two years, was completed, and it officially opened to traffic on September 30. The Jinshan Bridge is divided into the South Bridge and the North Bridge with Wentou Ridge as the boundary. The main line of the South Bridge is a two-way eight-lane road with a width of 45.5 meters, while the main line of the North Bridge is a two-way six-lane road with a width of 31.5 meters. The total length of the bridge is 2850 meters. At the time of its completion, it was the largest and longest-spanning mega bridge in Huizhou City, costing 360 million RMB.

head.text: The main line of the South Bridge

text: Wenshan Yanshan Airport  is a civil airport located in Yanshan County, Wenshan Prefecture, Yunnan Province, China. It is 9 kilometers away from Yanshan County and 28 kilometers away from Wenshan City, the capital of the prefecture. The airport's flight area is rated as 4C, with a runway length of 2400 meters and a width of 45 meters. The main landing direction of the runway is Category I precision approach, and the secondary landing direction is light approach system. In 2015, the passenger throughput exceeded 100,000. It is the stationed training base for several civil aviation companies. The airport is affiliated with Yunnan Airport Group Co., Ltd.

St. Peter's Cathedral  is the cathedral of the Roman Catholic Diocese of Trier, with a length of 112.5 meters  and a width of 41 meters . It is located in Trier, Germany, and is the oldest cathedral in Germany. This long-lived building has experienced several centuries, blending design elements from different generations. In 1986, it became a World Heritage Site designated by UNESCO along with other ancient Roman sites in Trier.

Peñafiel Castle is a castle located in the city of Peñafiel in the province of Valladolid, Spain. The castle is 150 meters  long and 10 meters  wide. The castle was listed as a national monument by the Spanish government in 1917.

Hans-Albers-Platz is a square in Hamburg, Germany, located in the St. Pauli district. It is named after the actor and singer Hans Albers and is a famous spot within the red-light district of Rope Street.
The Church of San Francisco de Sales  is a church in Madrid, Spain, named after Saint Francis de Sales. It was listed as a Spanish cultural property in 1996.

head.text: The Church of San Francisco de Sales
The Church of San Francisco de Sales

text: Yekaterina Park is a park in Tsar Village, Russia, located 25 kilometers southeast of St. Petersburg. Yekaterina Park is named after the Yekaterina Palace, and the park is divided into a garden and an English garden.

Hôtel de Ville station is a station shared by Paris Metro Line 1 and Paris Metro Line 11 in France, located in the 4th arrondissement of Paris. The platform of Line 1 was put into use on July 19, 1900, and the platform of Line 11 was put into use on April 28, 1935. The station is located next to the Paris City Hall, hence the name. There is a poster exhibition of the Paris Historical Institution on the platform of Line 1.
People's Square, located in Haigang District, Qinhuangdao City, Hebei Province, is a landmark building of Qinhuangdao City.

The Yubileiny Sports Palace is a stadium in Saint Petersburg, Russia, which can also be used to host concerts and other events. The Yubileiny Sports Palace can accommodate more than 7,000 spectators, mainly hosting ice hockey and basketball games.
Fairfax Bridge (English: Fairfax Bridge) is a deck arch bridge in Pierce County, Washington State, carrying Washington State Route 165.

The Post Office Headquarters Building is a structure in Belgrade, the capital of Serbia, near the Serbian Parliament Building, the Serbian Presidential Palace , and the Old Palace. This building is not only the center of Serbian postal services, but also one of the most representative buildings in Belgrade.

The Thuwunna Youth Training Centre Stadium is a comprehensive sports stadium located in Yangon, Myanmar, with 32,000 seats. It is smaller but newer than the Aung San Stadium. Both domestic and international football and track and field events are primarily held at the Thuwunna Stadium.

In order to accommodate the large crowds that flood in whenever there are sports events, rallies or concerts at the Stadium Merdeka and the National Stadium nearby, but the station is not used much on normal days. This station is also one of the closest to Jalan Petaling, with many tourist attractions in the old city area of Kuala Lumpur nearby. In the future, this station will be connected to Merdeka 118.

The Jiangling Olympic Park is a sports park located in Jiangling City, where 4 competition venues of the 2018 Winter Olympics are located. It will serve as an Olympic Park. It includes the following venues:
Heiwa Island Park is a park located in Heiwa Island, Ota District, Tokyo, Japan. It has a baseball field and swimming pools , and a square where barbecue activities can be held.
The National Monument  is a monument located on Dam Square in Amsterdam, the Netherlands.

Akiba Shrine, the main shrine of Akiba Mountain, is located near the top of Akiba Mountain in Hamamatsu City, Shizuoka Prefecture, Japan. The old shrine was a county shrine . It is the origin shrine of all Akiba shrines in Japan , Akiba Daiken and Akiba Temple.

tail.text: near the top of Akiba Mountain

text: The Hangzhou Mosque is located in the Shangcheng District of Hangzhou City, Zhejiang Province, China, and is an Islamic-style mosque. The Hangzhou Mosque is one of the largest mosques in China. The Hangzhou Islamic Association is also set up in the mosque.

Port of Spain  is the capital of Trinidad and Tobago, located on the western side of Trinidad Island by the Paria Bay. The population of Port of Spain is about 350,000, making it the third most populous city in the country, only after Chaguanas and San Fernando.
Anyang is currently planning to build the Anyang Northeast Henan Airport in Wagang Township, Tangyin County, which is designed as a civil feeder airport, about 28 kilometers from the city.

The Jingshan Alpine Skiing Center is a high mountain ski resort located on the Gariwang Mountain in Jingshan County, Gangwon Province, South Korea. Jingshan was the competition venue for the 2018 Winter Olympics, where alpine skiing, super giant slalom, and mixed skiing were held. The venue can accommodate 6500 people.
The Durdevica Tara Bridge is a concrete arch bridge located in the northern part of Montenegro on the Tara River.

Dongguang Temple, a Shingon sect of Toyama temple located in Nakano, Hunan Town, Koriyama City, Fukushima Prefecture. It is famous for having the largest wooden statue of Amitabha Buddha in Northeast Japan, "Nakaji Daibutsu".

Oku-Aizu Reservoir is a reservoir located in Hinoemata Village, Minamiaizu District, Fukushima Prefecture, and Uonuma City, Niigata Prefecture, Japan, belonging to the Agano River basin. The dam height of this reservoir ranks fifth in Japan and is also the highest gravity dam in Japan. Oku-Aizu Reservoir is also part of the Echigo Sanzan Tadami Quasi-National Park.

Huanhua Creek Park is located at No. 9 Qinghua Road, Qingyang District, Chengdu City, Sichuan Province, connecting to Du Fu Thatched Cottage in the north and Sichuan Provincial Museum in the east. It is the only five-star park in Chengdu.
Maki Station is a station located in Maki, Eiichiracho, Hashima City, Gifu Prefecture, on the Nagoya Railway  Takeguchi Line .

The Temple of San Miguel is a Baroque-style Roman Catholic Papal Basilica located in the center of Madrid, Spain. It is located on Calle de San Justo, adjacent to the Archbishop's Palace. It is the church of the Papal Nuncio in Spain, now managed by the Fathers of the Main Business.

The museum is located opposite the Natural History Museum and the Science Museum, in the very center of the Museum District on Exhibition Road in London, near Hyde Park. You can take the London Underground to South Kensington Station and walk for about 5 minutes. You can also take a bus and get off at the museum entrance on Cromwell Road.

tail.text: Museum District on Exhibition Road in London

text: The Old Railway Bridge is a bridge in Belgrade, the capital of Serbia, spanning the Sava River. This bridge was the first railway bridge in Belgrade and remained the only railway bridge in Belgrade until 1935. During the two World Wars, the Old Railway Bridge was demolished.

Kobe Sports Park World University Games Memorial Stadium is a multi-purpose stadium located in Kobe Sports Park in Kobe, Japan. It is most commonly used for football matches. The stadium can accommodate up to 45,000 people. It was built to host the 1985 Summer World University Games.

head.text: Kobe Sports Park World University Games Memorial Stadium

text: The Vincennes Stadium is a cycling stadium in the Vincennes Forest in Paris, France. This stadium was the main stadium for the 1900 Summer Olympics and the cycling venue for the 1924 Summer Olympics.
Hirohara Station is located in Takaharu Town, Nishimoro County, Miyazaki Prefecture, and is a station on the Yoshito Line of Kyushu Passenger Railway .

The Great Lavra Bell Tower is a bell tower of the Kiev Pechersk Lavra in Kiev, the capital of Ukraine, and it is also one of the most famous landmarks in the Kiev skyline. Between 1731 and 1745, this bell tower was the tallest freestanding bell tower in the world.

The site of the Town West Japanese Invasion Airport, located in Town West, Chaganhaote Tourism Economic Development Zone, Baicheng City, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit. The type is modern architecture, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by the Taobei District Cultural Management Office. The historical age of the Town West Japanese Invasion Airport site is 1938.

head.text: The site of the Town West Japanese Invasion Airport

text: Zhao Shan Avenue is a planned main urban road located in Tongzhou District, Beijing, China, extending east to Jian Yun Gou. It is part of the "Yudai River Avenue - Zhao Shan Avenue" horizontal passage in the "Eleven Horizontal and Nine Vertical" road network system of Beijing's urban sub-center.

Traktor Ice Arena is an indoor ice arena located in Chelyabinsk, Russia. It is used for various indoor activities and is also the home field for the KHL team Chelyabinsk Tractor and the MHL team Chelyabinsk Polar Bears.

Duwen Temple, a Tiantai Buddhist temple in Tarumi Ward, Kobe City, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. The mountain is called Jixiang Mountain, and the main deity worshipped is Bishamonten. Because of the Benten Pond Bridge and Swallow Flower in the temple, it is considered one of the "famous places for flowers in Kobe".

The Art Bridge is a pedestrian bridge over the Vardar River in the center of Skopje, the capital of North Macedonia. The feature of the Art Bridge is that it is decorated with numerous statues of famous Macedonian artists and musicians. The Art Bridge is part of the Skopje 2014 project and cost 2.5 million euros to build.

The Toronto Transit Commission provides several public transportation services in the city center, including two subway lines  and surface trams. In addition, the GO Transit company also provides commuter rail services connecting the Union Station in the city center with suburban towns. There are two highways in the area, namely the east-west Gardiner Expressway and the north-south Don Valley Parkway, both of which are managed by the transportation department of Toronto.

Ningjiang Mosque, located in Ningjiang District, Songyuan City, Jilin Province, China, is a provincial-level cultural relic protection unit. The type is ancient architecture, and the announcement time is May 31, 2007. This cultural relic protection unit is managed by Ningjiang District Cultural Management Office. The historical era of Ningjiang Mosque is the Qing Dynasty.

Ostrih Castle is a castle building located in the western Ukrainian city of Ostrih. From the 14th to the 16th century, the castle was one of the main strongholds of the Ostroh family. Now only ruins of the castle remain.

Makomanai Open Stadium, is a stadium located in Makomanai Park, Minami Ward, Sapporo City, Hokkaido, Japan. The stadium was opened in February 1971 and can accommodate 17,324 people. It was used as the main stadium for the 1972 Winter Olympics.
The Church of St. Joseph is a Roman Catholic church in Madrid, Spain, located in the city center on Alcala Street. In 1995, the Church of St. Joseph was listed as a Spanish cultural property.

The Kamianets-Podilskyi Castle is a castle located in the western Ukrainian city of Kamianets-Podilskyi. The castle is now one of the candidates for World Heritage Sites, and also one of the seven architectural wonders of Ukraine.

The Shijiazhuang Railway Museum, which is planned to be located in the railway museum of the second generation station building of China Railway Shijiazhuang Station, is located on the east side of Liberation Square in Qiaoxi District, Shijiazhuang City, Hebei Province, China.
The Artillery Museum, officially known as the Military History Museum of Artillery, Engineer and Signal Corps, is a military museum located in Saint Petersburg, Russia.
The Kyoto National Museum of Modern Art, located in Okazaki Park in Sakyo Ward, Kyoto City, is operated by the Independent Administrative Institution National Museum of Art.

head.text: The Kyoto National Museum of Modern Art

text: Tsarevets Fortress is a medieval fortress located in Veliko Tarnovo in northern Bulgaria. The building was the most important fortress of the Second Bulgarian Empire from 1185 to 1393, and now it is a popular tourist attraction.
Perm Bolshoye Savino Airport  is an international airport primarily serving Perm, Russia, located 16 kilometers  southwest of Perm. It is a dual-use military and civilian airport.
The Westin Palace Madrid is a luxury hotel in Madrid, Spain, located in the central district of Calle de San Jerónimo and Plaza de Canovas.

The Kurozweki Castle is a castle ruin located in the Holy Cross Province in southern Poland. This castle was originally built by a Polish nobleman. In 1655, the castle was partially destroyed by the Swedes, and then it became a ruin in the Russian invasion in 1770.

Goose Market Square is a triangular city public square in Hamburg, Germany, located in the New Town of Hamburg. It is connected to the Virgin Dam in the east, Dammtorstraße and Valentinskamp in the northwest, and ABC-Straße in the south.

Falkland Palace, located in Falkland, Scotland, was once the palace of the Scottish king. Now, Falkland Palace is managed by the National Trust for Scotland. Before the construction of Falkland Palace, there was a hunting lodge here.
Sperlinga Castle  is a castle in Milan, Italy.

Cou Ijin-kan is a foreign-style building located in Ikuta District, Kobe City, Hyogo Prefecture, Japan. It is also part of the traditional architecture preserved in the Kitano/Yamamoto area. Since 2012, Yoshimi Kisen has been the tenant of this building and uses it as a guest house.

The Chakovec Castle is a medieval castle in the northern Croatian city of Chakovec. The castle is located in the Jelenski Park, not far from the city center square. On November 19, 2007, the Chakovec Castle was listed as a registered cultural protection building in Croatia.
Choto Sonar Mosque  is an ancient mosque located in Nawabganj district, Bangladesh.

Okayama Temple is a Tendai Buddhist temple located in the North District of Okayama City, Okayama Prefecture. The mountain is called Kinko Mountain, with Amitabha Tathagata, Thousand-Hand Guanyin, and Shakyamuni Tathagata as the main deities. Before the Middle Ages, it was in the Okayama Castle .
The Woodland Cemetery is a cemetery in the southern part of Stockholm, the capital of Sweden. Its design style reflects the development from romantic nationalism to pragmatism.

Houge Station is located in Ganjingzi District, Dalian City, Liaoning Province. It is a station of Dalian Metro Line 2 and was put into operation on September 30, 2022, with the opening of the second phase of Line 2.

The Column of the Virgin Mary in Olomouc is a Baroque monument located in the Czech Republic's Olomouc, situated on the Lower Square of Olomouc. It was built for the grand Catholic thanksgiving ceremony held to appease the Black Death that attacked Moravia (now the Czech Republic) from 1714 to 1716.
The Big Obukhovsky Bridge is the newest bridge built on the Neva River in the Russian city of St. Petersburg, and it is also the only fishing bridge on the Neva River, located in the Nevsky District.

The Kuala Lumpur Second International Airport Station  is located in the Kuala Lumpur Second International Airport in Sepang, Selangor, Malaysia, and was opened for operation simultaneously with the Kuala Lumpur Second International Airport  on May 2, 2014.

head.text: The Kuala Lumpur Second International Airport Station

text: The Knin Fortress is a castle located in the city of Knin in the Dalmatian region of Croatia, situated on the highest mountain of the city, near the Krka River. This fortress is the second largest fortress building in Europe. Now it is a famous tourist attraction.
Asteroid 3717  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On February 15, 1964, this celestial body was discovered by Indiana University in Morgan County. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 57.58365.
Asteroid 4588  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On March 13, 1931, Max Wolf discovered this celestial body in Heidelberg. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 123.55617.
Asteroid 6529  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On December 14, 1993, it was discovered by Palomar Mountain at Palomar Mountain. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 266.99350.
Asteroid 3732  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On September 27, 1984, Zdenka Vavrova discovered this celestial body at Klet. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 8.53768.
Asteroid 5532  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On February 14, 1932, this celestial body was discovered by Karl Wilhelm Reinmuth in Heidelberg. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 67.09293.
Asteroid 5509  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On September 8, 1988, Vermont Bergen discovered this celestial body in Tautenburg. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 89.63575424944243.

Asteroid 5519  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On August 23, 1990, this celestial body was discovered by Henry E. Holt at Palomar Mountain. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 291.111942470346.

Asteroid 5541  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On October 22, 1976, this celestial body was discovered by Youju Kousai and Kiichiro Furukawa in Kiso Town, and was named after the Yin-Yang master Abe no Seimei . The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 199.6067651103206.
Asteroid 5517  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On June 4, 1989, Eleanor Helin discovered this celestial body at Palomar Mountain. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 118.8716068126686.
Asteroid 6539  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On August 19, 1982, Zdenka Vavrova discovered this celestial body in Klet. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 23.99836.

Asteroid 5511, also known as 5511Cloanthus, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by Carolyn Shoemaker and Eugene Shoemaker at Palomar Mountain on October 8, 1988. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 121.95182.

Asteroid 4625, also known as 4625 Shchedrin, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by Ludmila Karachkina on October 20, 1982, in Crimea. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 13.32320477313439.
Asteroid 6538  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On September 25, 1981, this celestial body was discovered by Ludmila Chernykh in Crimea. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 146.3042840131234.
Asteroid 3703  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On August 9, 1978, it was discovered by Ludmila Chernykh in Crimea. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 151.9177086222482.

Asteroid 5521, also known as 5521 Morpurgo, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by Elinor Helin at Palomar Mountain on August 15, 1991. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 266.9649315345746.

Asteroid 5507, also known as 5507 Niijima, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by Kenzo Suzuki and Takeshi Urata in Toyota City on October 21, 1987. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 22.25621.

Asteroid 3736  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On September 26, 1987, this celestial body was discovered by Edward Powell in Coconino County. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 146.3187077264432.
Asteroid 6506  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On March 15, 1978, this celestial body was discovered by Schulte Bass at Palomar Mountain. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 229.22793.
Asteroid 5349  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On September 7, 1988, Eleanor Helin discovered this celestial body at Palomar Mountain. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 80.43458409840686.

Asteroid 5538, also known as 5538 Luichewoo, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by the Purple Mountain Observatory in Nanjing on October 9, 1964. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 45.66455.

Asteroid 6509  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On February 12, 1983, Henry Debehogne and G.DeSanctis discovered this celestial body at the La Silla Observatory. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 102.32153.

Asteroid 5529  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On September 24, 1960, C.J. Van Houten, I. Van Houten-Groeneveld, T. Gehrels discovered this celestial body at Palomar Mountain. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 234.9720560804971.
Asteroid 6527  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On October 31, 1992, A.Natori and Takeshi Urata discovered this celestial body in Shimizu Town. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 107.46238.

M10  is a globular cluster located in the constellation Ophiuchus, with an apparent magnitude of 6.6 and a distance of 14,000 light-years from Earth. The position of M10 is close to the center of Ophiuchus, 3.4 degrees away from M12, and its structure is relatively loose. In the absence of light pollution, it can be seen with a 4-inch  telescope.
Asteroid 5518  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On December 30, 1989, J.M.Baur discovered this celestial body in Giaons. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 140.22722.

Asteroid 4581  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On March 31, 1989, this celestial body was discovered by Henry E. Holt and N.G.Thomas at Palomar Mountain. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 255.3023486711961.

Asteroid 6526, also known as 6526 Matogawa, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by Marugame Kin and Watanabe Hiroshi in Kitami on October 1, 1992. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 166.81697.

Asteroid 6520  is an asteroid orbiting the sun. On April 16, 1991, Tetsu Otomo and Osamu Muramatsu discovered this celestial body in Fujieda City. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 62.94774837654602.

Asteroid 5539, also known as 5539 Limporyen, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by the Purple Mountain Observatory in Nanjing on October 16, 1965. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 121.8796923979736.

The Ellerman crater is a impact crater located in the southern half of the far side of the moon, which was formed approximately between 32 and 11 billion years ago during the Eratosthenian period. It was named after the American astronomer Ferdinand Ellerman , and was officially accepted by the International Astronomical Union in 1970.

tail.text: the far side of the moon

text: Wei Su Ba is the second brightest star in Scorpio, and also one of the brightest stars in the night sky. Although Wei Su Ba is the second brightest star in Scorpio, it is named λ in the Bayer naming system. Its English common name Shaula comes from the Arabic الشولاءal-šawlā´, which means "raised tail", because it forms the tail of the scorpion (Scorpio).

Asteroid 55892  (Fuzhou Gezhi Star) is a main belt asteroid discovered by the Schmidt CCD Asteroid Program of the National Astronomical Observatory of the Chinese Academy of Sciences in Xinglong County on December 1, 1997. In 2006, the asteroid 55892 discovered by the research group led by Academician Chen Jiansheng, an alumnus of Fuzhou Gezhi Middle School, was named "Fuzhou Gezhi Star" (Fuzhou Gezhi).

tail.text: the Schmidt CCD Asteroid Program of the National Astronomical Observatory of the Chinese Academy of Sciences
the asteroid 55892 discovered by the research group led by Academician Chen Jiansheng, an alumnus of Fuzhou Gezhi Middle School

text: Asteroid 7854, also known as Laozi Star, was discovered by Dutch astronomers Cornelis Johannes van Houten, Ingrid van Houten-Groeneveld, and American astronomer Tom Gehrels on October 17, 1977. Asteroid 7854 is named after Laozi, a famous ancient Chinese thinker and the master of Taoist thought.

Unukalhai, also known as Tian Shi You Yuan Qi, is a binary star located in the head of the constellation Serpens on the celestial equator. Its apparent magnitude is 2.6, making it the brightest star in Serpens, visible to the naked eye from Earth. Parallax measurements estimate its distance from the sun to be about 74 light years .

Alkmene, also known as the Resentful Female Star, is the 82nd asteroid discovered by humans, which was found on November 27, 1864. The diameter of the Resentful Female Star is 61.0 kilometers, with a mass of 2.4×1017 kilograms, and an orbital period of 1674.795 days.

NGC1275  is a type 1.5 Seyfert galaxy, located in the direction of Perseus, about 235 million light years away. NGC1275 corresponds to the radio galaxy Perseus A, which is a galaxy located in the center of the huge Perseus galaxy cluster.

Asteroid 3611, also known as Dabu Star, is a main-belt asteroid discovered by Purple Mountain Observatory on December 20, 1981. Asteroid 3611 was discovered by the observatory staff Yang Jiexing, and the asteroid was named after his hometown, Dabu County, Meizhou City, Guangdong Province. This is also the first asteroid in mainland China named after a county.

Asteroid 4571, also known as 4571 Grumiaux, is an asteroid orbiting the sun. It was discovered by Henri Debehogne at La Silla Observatory on September 8, 1985. The absolute magnitude of this asteroid is 172.8269668176067.

NGC1317 is a twisted spiral galaxy in Fornax. It and NGC1316 are sometimes collectively referred to as the Fornax Radio Galaxies, because these galaxies are strong radiation sources in the universe. These two galaxies began to merge about 100 million years ago.

The Galactic Center, also known as the center of the Milky Way, is the central area around which the Milky Way revolves, and it is also the brightest area in the entire Milky Way. The Galactic Center is located in the constellations of Sagittarius, Ophiuchus, and Scorpius, about 8,000 parsecs  away from Earth.

tail.text: the center of the Milky Way

text: The diameter of NGC1073 is approximately 80,000 light years, and it can be observed with a medium-sized amateur telescope. NGC1073 is a barred spiral galaxy similar to the Milky Way; the difference is that NGC1073 does not have highly formed symmetrical spiral arms, and the central bar structure is larger.

Minerva  is an asteroid located in the asteroid belt, numbered 93, discovered by James Craig Watson on August 24, 1867. The diameter of Minerva is 141.0 kilometers, the mass is 2.9×1018 kilograms, and the orbital period is 1669.541 days. In 2009, Minerva was found to have two satellites with diameters of about 3 to 4 kilometers, which are 630 and 380 kilometers away from Minerva respectively.

Diffuse nebulae, meaning hazy, cloudy. Diffuse nebulae have no regular shape and no clear boundaries. In fact, apart from the ring-symmetric planetary nebulae, all nebulae can be called irregularly shaped diffuse nebulae. Diffuse nebulae vary in size, the largest can reach hundreds of light years, with an average diameter of tens of light years, and an average density of 10-100 atoms/cm3. The mass of most diffuse nebulae is around 10 solar masses. Diffuse nebulae are diverse and can be divided into bright nebulae and dark nebulae.

NGC1323 is a lens-shaped galaxy located in the southern part of Eridanus. It is estimated that this celestial body is about 266 million light years away from the Milky Way, with a span of about 70,000 light years. This celestial body was discovered by the Irish physicist George Johnstone Stoney on December 19, 1849.

Zhongda Star , temporarily numbered 2006GJ, is an asteroid in the asteroid belt. It was discovered by Yang Tingzhang and Ye Quanzhi at the Lulin Observatory of the National Central University on April 1, 2006. It is named after the abbreviation "Zhongda" of the National Central University.

tail.text: the abbreviation "Zhongda" of the National Central University

text: NGC1232 is an intermediate spiral galaxy in Eridanus, about 60 million light years away from Earth. It was discovered by Friedrich Wilhelm Herschel on October 20, 1784.

JKCS041 is a galaxy cluster jointly discovered by ground-based optical telescopes, the Chandra X-ray Observatory of NASA, and the Spitzer Space Telescope. This galaxy cluster has a redshift of 1.9, is 10.2 billion light-years away from Earth, and has surpassed XMMXCS2215-1738 discovered in 2006, becoming the most distant galaxy cluster discovered so far.

NGC1313 is a galaxy in the constellation of Reticulum. It was discovered by the Australian astronomer James Dunlop on September 27, 1826. It has a prominent uneven shape, and its axis does not completely revolve around its center. Near NGC1313, there is another galaxy, NGC1309.

NGC1333 is a reflection nebula located in the constellation Perseus. It is about a thousand light-years away from the Earth and is part of the Perseus molecular cloud. The nebula was discovered by the German astronomer Edward Schönfeld on December 1, 1855. In 2011, astronomers announced the discovery of 30 to 30 brown dwarfs within the nebula and the Serpens ρ nebula complex.

NGC918 is a barred spiral galaxy in Aries, with relatively loose spiral arms, classified as SBc type, and is about sixty million light years away from Earth. The galaxy was discovered by John Frederick William Herschel on January 11, 1831. In 2009, astronomers discovered a type II supernova SN2009js in the galaxy.

HD102117 has a planet orbiting it, named HD102117b. It is the only planet found in this star system so far. Its mass is only 0.14 times that of Jupiter. Its orbital period is 20.67 days. It was discovered on February 14, 2004.

Asteroid 951 is an S-type asteroid very close to the inner edge of the asteroid belt. Its name was given by the discoverer based on a tourist attraction on the Crimean Peninsula. Asteroid 951 is the first asteroid visited by a human spacecraft. On October 29, 1991, the Galileo spacecraft passed by this asteroid on its way to Jupiter.

tail.text: a tourist attraction on the Crimean Peninsula

text: Frost Lion Nebula is a protoplanetary nebula , located in Leo, about 10,000 light-years away from Earth . Its spectrum is bipolar nebula. The visible light spectrum of its central star is K7II, its ontology is called Frost Lion, and it is located on the plane of our Milky Way . Further in 1990, it was the only known PPN with an ice crystal flow dominating the long-wave radiation spectrum of the circumstellar ring, and it was also the only known PPN with point reflection symmetry from axial symmetry difference.

Kepler-8b is one of the first 5 exoplanets discovered by the Kepler Space Telescope, announced on January 4, 2012. It is located in the constellation Lyra, orbiting the star Kepler-8. The radius of Kepler-8b is 2.219 times that of Jupiter, and its mass is 12.7 times that of Jupiter. Its mass and size also rank first among all planets, and they are still increasing.

Kappa Centauri is a star in the constellation Centaurus. It rotates at a very high speed, with a rotation period of less than one day. Kappa Centauri is a Be star, that is, the radiation of its hydrogen spectral lines is variable, so the brightness of Kappa Centauri also varies slightly, and it is classified as a Gamma Cassiopeiae variable star. Kappa Centauri is about 309 light years away from the earth. The mass of Kappa Centauri is very large, and it is on the boundary of evolution into a white dwarf and a supernova.
NGC909 is a galaxy of Andromeda.
NGC907 is a galaxy in Cetus.

Kepler-5, also known as Kepler-5 in English, is a sun-like star located in the constellation Cygnus. This star was discovered by the Kepler Space Telescope. The Kepler Space Telescope discovered in 2010 that Kepler-5 has a planet, Kepler-5b. This discovery was announced on January 4, 2010.

Centauri 4 is a star within the constellation of Centaurus, suspected by scientists to be a quadruple star system, belonging to the B-type blue-white subgiant, with a visual magnitude of +4.75, 670 light years away from the Earth.
NGC903 is a galaxy in Aries.
NGC1316 is a lens galaxy in the Fornax constellation. About 100 million years ago, it began to devour a smaller neighboring spiral galaxy, NGC1317.

NGC1097 has two satellite galaxies: the dwarf elliptical galaxy NGC1097A is the larger of the two, it is a peculiar elliptical galaxy, orbiting around the core of NGC1097 at a distance of 42,000 light years. The dwarf galaxy NGC1097B is further out, and we know very little about it.

NGC1032 is a spiral galaxy about 117 million light-years away from the Earth, located in the constellation Cetus. In January 2005, astronomers discovered the supernova SN2005E within NGC1032, which is a calcium-rich supernova.
The Bird God Star was discovered on March 31, 2005, and the International Astronomical Union recognized it as a dwarf planet on July 11, 2008.
Eris was discovered on January 5, 2005, and was referred to as the tenth planet in media reports. The International Astronomical Union recognized it as a dwarf planet on September 13, 2006.

The Kaidun meteorite is a meteorite that fell within a former Soviet military base in Yemen on December 3, 1980.
