It is reported that hair loss symptoms generally occur 1 to 3 weeks after acute thallium poisoning, and the shortest is within 4 days. The hair loss caused by thallium poisoning will fall out in bundles, causing bald spots. This type of hair loss is usually reversible, and the hair will generally start to regrow about 4 weeks after the cure of thallium poisoning, and it will fully recover in 3 months. However, it has been reported that severe thallium poisoning can cause permanent hair loss.

Haemolacria, a phenomenon of the body, refers to the eyes discharging tears containing some blood for unknown reasons. This could be a symptom of various diseases, or a phenomenon of tumors in the lacrimal apparatus. The most common possibility is conjunctivitis caused by bacteria, environmental damage or injury. Fertile women may also experience a kind of acute haemolacria, which is a pathological change caused by hormones, just like the bleeding phenomenon caused by endometrial displacement.

Retrograde ejaculation refers to a disease in which, during normal sexual intercourse, the male does not ejaculate normally from the urethra after feeling and acting ejaculation, but instead ejaculates retrogradely into the bladder. Since the ejaculation process is controlled by the bladder neck sphincter, retrograde ejaculation may be related to the weakness of the sphincter or abnormal nerve control. In addition, retrograde ejaculation may also be related to ejaculatory duct obstruction and transurethral prostatectomy. Retrograde ejaculation is often associated with the so-called "ejaculation-free orgasm" and is one of the causes of male infertility.

tail.text: may be related to the weakness of the sphincter or abnormal nerve control
a disease in which, during normal sexual intercourse, the male does not ejaculate normally from the urethra after feeling and acting ejaculation, but instead ejaculates retrogradely into the bladder

text: T-cell lymphoma includes four types of lymphomas that affect T cells. These explanations may account for one-tenth of the cases of non-Hodgkin's lymphoma. T-cell lymphoma is accompanied by diseases of the human herpesvirus type 4 and the human T-cell leukemia virus-1.

A bone fracture refers to a medical condition where the continuity of the skeleton is partially or completely broken. In severe cases, the skeleton may shatter into several pieces. Bone fractures can be caused by strong impacts or pressure; in certain medical conditions where the skeleton is weakened (such as osteoporosis, bone deficiency, bone cancer, osteogenesis imperfecta), even minor trauma can cause bone fractures, which are known as pathological fractures.

tail.text: the skeleton may shatter into several pieces
the continuity of the skeleton is partially or completely broken

text: The pathogen of malaria is Plasmodium, a kind of intracellular parasitic unicellular organism, belonging to the genus Plasmodium of Apicomplexa. They use mosquitoes as intermediate hosts and spread pathogens through female mosquito bites. Plasmodium can infect most vertebrates, which allows biologists to study malaria by establishing biological models (such as using mice for malaria pathology research).

Monkeypox is caused by the monkeypox virus. It is a kind of enveloped double-stranded DNA virus, belonging to the Orthopoxvirus genus of the Poxviridae family . Genomic sequencing has identified two evolutionarily distinct branches of the monkeypox virus - the Congo Basin  branch and the West Africa branch, the former usually leads to more severe diseases, higher mortality rates, and more frequent human-to-human transmission.

Bronchiolitis obliterans, is a disease caused by inflammation leading to obstruction of the bronchioles in the lungs. Symptoms include dry cough, shortness of breath, wheezing, and fatigue, which generally worsen over several weeks or months, and this is unrelated to cryptogenic organizing pneumonia.

tail.text: inflammation leading to obstruction of the bronchioles in the lungs
dry cough, shortness of breath, wheezing, and fatigue

text: Vocal fold cyst, a submucosal layer forms a retention cyst due to glandular secretion blockage, or an epithelial cyst due to epidermal invagination. Microsurgery can be used to remove the cyst. Vocal cord nodule: common in singers and teachers.

tail.text: a submucosal layer forms a retention cyst due to glandular secretion blockage

text: Keratoderma blennorrhagicum  is a skin manifestation of reactive arthritis, seen in about 15% of patients with reactive arthritis. The affected areas are usually located on the palms or soles of the feet, but may also spread to the scrotum, scalp, or trunk. The appearance of keratoderma blennorrhagicum is similar to psoriasis, usually presenting as brownish-yellow waxy blisters or purulent lesions. The lesions may merge to form papules with a hard shell, with scaly desquamation at the edges. It should be distinguished from seborrheic keratosis, a common benign skin tumor.

tail.text: The appearance of keratoderma blennorrhagicum is similar to psoriasis

text: Jefferson fracture, refers to a special type of fracture of the first cervical vertebra , which is a type of burst fracture of the atlas. In 1920, British neurosurgeon Geoffrey Jefferson first reported 4 cases of this type of bone injury, and subsequently reported this injury, and the medical community later named this special type of atlas arch fracture as Jefferson fracture.

Mucinous tumors, a type of ovarian tumor under the surface epithelial stromal tumors, account for about 36% of all ovarian tumors. Approximately 75% of cases are benign tumors, 10% are borderline tumors, and 15% are malignant tumors. In very rare cases, the tumor occurs in both ovaries, and only 5% of benign mucinous tumors are bilateral tumors.

Precursor B-cell lymphoblastic leukemia is a form of Lymphoid leukemia, where most of the B-cell lymphoblasts (Lymphoblast, immature white blood cells) are found in the blood and bone marrow. It is also the most common type of Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL). It is sometimes classified as "lymphoma", as referred to as "leukemia/lymphoma".

Cerebrovascular disease includes all medical symptoms that affect the brain vessels and cerebral circulation. A common sign of cerebrovascular disease is damage or deformation of the arteries that supply oxygen and nutrients to the brain.

Mucinous cystadenoma, a type of mucinous cystadenoma that grows in the ovaries, is usually a benign tumor. Malignant tumors are very rare, accounting for only 10% of mucinous cystadenomas and 5% of primary ovarian malignant tumor cases. In 15%-30% of cases, the disease occurs on both sides of the ovaries, with the peak incidence age being 40 to 70 years old.

Heart disease is a general term for heart diseases, including rheumatic heart disease, congenital heart disease, hypertensive heart disease, coronary heart disease, myocarditis and other heart diseases.
Carcinosarcoma, is a type of malignant tumor, its main types include lung carcinosarcoma and uterine sarcoma.

Choriocarcinoma is a malignant cancer located in the trophoblast, usually found in the placenta. It belongs to the late stage of gestational trophoblastic disease and is also a germ cell tumor, which occurs in the testicles or ovaries.
Sex cord tumour with annular tubules  is a rare ovarian tumor, which is a type of sex cord-stromal tumor.

The clinical diagnosis of gastroenteritis is usually based on the patient's symptoms and signs. It is often unnecessary to determine the exact cause, as it does not affect the treatment of the disease. However, for those with bloody stools and those who may have food poisoning, or those who have recently traveled to developing countries, stool culture should be implemented. Some diagnostic tests are also necessary to detect the condition. Because hypoglycemia occurs in almost 10% of infants and children, it is recommended to implement serum glucose determination in this group. Electrotherapy and kidney function should also be tested.

The crayfish plague fungus  is a type of water mold that can infect freshwater crayfish. The organisms of the European river crayfish genus will die within a few weeks after infection. Crayfish in Australia, Papua New Guinea, and Japan also have the possibility of infection. It is listed as one of the top 100 invasive species in the world by the Invasive Species Specialist Group  of the International Union for Conservation of Nature's Species Survival Commission.

tail.text: The organisms of the European river crayfish genus will die within a few weeks after infection

text: The most common symptom of acute pancreatitis is severe upper abdominal burning pain radiating to the back. The pain varies depending on the severity and internal bleeding. Blood pressure may increase or decrease, and the rate of heart bleeding and respiration will also increase. Chronic pancreatitis can lead to diabetes or pancreatic cancer. Unexplained weight loss may occur, and the lack of pancreatic enzymes may hinder digestion.

tail.text: severe upper abdominal burning pain radiating to the back

text: Uremic pericarditis is a form of pericarditis. It can lead to fibrinous pericarditis. The cause of the disease is little known.

After Fang Yuan finished her honeymoon, she started to feel nauseous, lost her appetite, and felt weak all over. Her husband learned from books that the symptoms of pregnancy are chills, dizziness, fatigue, sleepiness, drooling, loss of appetite, liking sour food or disliking greasy food, nausea, and morning sickness.

tail.text: chills, dizziness, fatigue, sleepiness, drooling, loss of appetite, liking sour food or disliking greasy food, nausea, and morning sickness

text: Xiao Li's eyes were red and swollen, and they itched. He looked up in books and found that the symptoms of conjunctivitis include a foreign body sensation in the eye, burning, itching, and tearing.

tail.text: a foreign body sensation in the eye, burning, itching, and tearing

text: Recently, Wang Meili feels dizzy as soon as she gets up, and feels palpitations after a few steps. Her parents learned from books that the symptoms of hypoglycemia are sweating, hunger, palpitations, trembling, and pale complexion.

tail.text: sweating, hunger, palpitations, trembling, and pale complexion

text: Xiao Wang often has difficulty breathing, suddenly coughs and gasps, he consulted books and learned that the symptoms of asthma are expiratory dyspnea with wheezing or paroxysmal coughing, chest tightness, etc. during an attack.

tail.text: expiratory dyspnea with wheezing or paroxysmal coughing, chest tightness, etc. during an attack

text: Recently, Wang Ming has been very upset, restless, and irritable, finding it hard to calm down. His parents learned from books that the symptoms of anxiety disorder are that the patient feels constantly in a state of tension, fear, and worry.

tail.text: the patient feels constantly in a state of tension, fear, and worry

text: 10-year-old Lele is already 1.8 meters tall, his development is close to that of an adult man. His parents learned from books that the symptoms of gigantism are excessive growth during childhood, tall stature, rapid growth of limbs, increased appetite, and extraordinary arm strength.

tail.text: excessive growth during childhood, tall stature, rapid growth of limbs, increased appetite, and extraordinary arm strength

text: As soon as it gets dark, Zhang Dongming can't see things around him clearly. He learned from reading books that the symptoms of night blindness are difficulty seeing or completely unable to see things in dim light or at night, and difficulty moving.

tail.text: difficulty seeing or completely unable to see things in dim light or at night, and difficulty moving

text: The Dharma Frog (scientific name: Pelophylax porosus) is a frog species unique to Japan, which can be divided into two subspecies: Tokyo Dharma Frog (P.porosus porosus) and Nagoya Dharma Frog (P.porosus brevipodus). The species epithet "Porosus" means "porous".

Waltheria indica, also known as Florida Waltheria, Sleepy Morning, Basora Prieta, Hierba de Soldado, Guimauve, Mauve-gris, Moto-branco, Fulutafu, Kafaki, Uhaloa (Hawaii), is a species under the genus of Waltheria in the family of Malvaceae. The species name "indica" means "from India".

The Sandbar Shark (scientific name: Carcharhinus plumbeus), also known as the Thickfin Shark, is one of the species of the Carcharhinidae family in the Carcharhiniformes order of the Chondrichthyes class.

The Monochromatic Naked Chest Eel, also known as the Monochromatic Naked Chest Moray, is one of the species of the Moray family in the suborder of Moray under the order of Anguilliformes in the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the Eastern Atlantic region, from the southern part of Portugal to the waters of the Cape Verde Islands, including the Mediterranean Sea. It can inhabit depths of up to 20 meters and can grow up to 100 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives on the reef slopes with sandy and rocky bottoms. It is carnivorous and can be used as food fish and game fish. The species epithet unicolor means "monochromatic".

The Blue Crab is distributed in the Atlantic, the Caribbean Sea, and the Gulf of Mexico from the United States to Colombia. Its northern boundary is located in Delaware Bay. The species in the genus Callinectes are easily confused, and it is now believed that all the crabs claimed to be C.danae and C.ornatus in the Gulf of Mexico  are actually Blue Crabs.

The Netted Moray, also known as the Netted Moray Eel, is one of the species of the Moray Eel family in the suborder of Moray, order of Eel, and class of Ray-finned Fish. It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, from New England to the Gulf of Mexico, inhabiting depths of 2-60 meters. It can grow up to 60 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives on the continental shelf and is carnivorous. Its habits are unknown.

The Ema's Naked Chest Eel, also known as Ema's Naked Chest Moray, is one of the species of the Moray family in the suborder of Moray, order of Anguilliformes, class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the waters of Vietnam in the Western Pacific region, with a habitat depth of 14-100 meters and a body length of up to 43 centimeters. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in sandy and muddy seabed areas and is carnivorous. Its habits are unknown.

tail.text: the waters of Vietnam in the Western Pacific region

text: The Leopard Moray, also known as Leopard Moray Eel, Money Eel, Potato Eel, Tiger Eel, is one of the species of the Moray family in the suborder of Moray Eels under the order of Anguilliformes of the class of Ray-finned Fish. It is distributed in the Indo-Pacific region, from Sri Lanka to the Fiji Islands and brackish waters. It can grow up to 150 cm in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in coastal and estuarine areas. It is carnivorous, but its habits are not clear. It can be used as a food fish.

The Brown Big-headed Ant (scientific name: Pheidole megacephala), also known as the Tropical Big-headed House Ant, is a species of ant under the genus Pheidole of the ant family. It is one of the most dominant invasive species in Australia, locally known as the coastal brown ant, posing a huge threat to the survival of native ants. It is one of the top 100 invasive species in the world. It was first described by John Christian Fabricius in Mauritius in 1793, but the same species had been found in Egypt 18 years earlier. In addition, the Brown Big-headed Ant is distributed all over the world.

The Kinosternidae, also known as the mud turtle family, is a family under the superfamily Kinosternoidea of the order Testudines. It currently includes 4 genera and 25 species of small carnivorous turtles, with shell lengths generally between 10-15 cm , but species of the musk turtle genus can grow up to 30 cm . In addition, three genera have already become extinct.

The Eye-spot Moray, also known as the Eye-spot Naked Chest Moray, is one of the species of the Moray family in the suborder of Moray and the order of Eel. It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, including the Greater Antilles, Nicaragua to the northern waters of South America. It inhabits depths of 1-160 meters and can grow up to 90 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in sandy and muddy seabed areas. It is carnivorous, feeding on fish and crustaceans, and can be used as food fish.
Diplazium simile, also known as the Thorny Double-Cover Fern or Thorny Short-Intestine Fern, is a species under the genus Diplazium of the family Athyriaceae.

The Peacock Moray, also known as the Peacock Eel, is a species of the Moray Eel family, a suborder of the Eel order, in the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, from northeastern Brazil to the Mid-Atlantic Ridge, inhabiting depths of 2-60 meters. It can reach a length of 51.2 centimeters, is a bottom-dwelling fish, lives in reef areas, and is carnivorous. Its habits are unknown.

Amanita verna, also known as White Deadly Mushroom or Spring Amanita, is a fungus of the genus Amanita in the family Amanitaceae of the order Agaricales. It is a highly lethal poisonous mushroom. The large fruiting body  appears in spring, which is different from the growth time of Amanita virosa, which often appears in summer and autumn. Its cap, stem, and gills are all white.

The Latticed Fangblenny, also known as the Latticed Dragonet, is one of the species of the Dragonet family in the suborder of Perch and the order of Perch-like fish of the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the western Pacific region of India, including the Chagos Islands, Thailand, the Ryukyu Islands, the Philippines, New Guinea, and other sea areas. It inhabits depths of 8-85 meters and can reach a length of 40 centimeters. It lives in sandy and muddy sea areas near coral reefs and is carnivorous, feeding on fish and invertebrates. It can be used as a food fish.

Maclura pomifera, also known as Chinese mulberry, Chinese fruit , Horse apple, Osage orange, bow wood, orange mulberry, is a plant of the orange mulberry genus in the mulberry family. Because the appearance of the fruit is like the shape of the brain, it is commonly known as monkey brain fruit.

The Narrow-bridged Musk Turtle (scientific name: Claudius angustatus), also known as the Hawk-billed Mud Turtle, Narrow-bridged Musk Turtle, and Narrow-bridged Egg Turtle, is the only species of the genus Claudius in the subfamily of Musk Turtles. It is native to the freshwaters of Mexico, Guatemala, and Belize, with a shell length of about 15 centimeters. It is carnivorous, mainly feeding on aquatic mollusks and also eating carrion.

The Sharp-toothed Moray, also known as the Sharp-toothed Hook-nosed Moray, is one of the species of the Moray family under the order of Anguilliformes and the class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Eastern Atlantic region, including the Azores, Madeira Islands, Canary Islands, Cape Verde Islands, Saint Helena, etc. It inhabits at a depth of 3-60 meters and can grow up to 120 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in gravel and rocky seabed areas. It is carnivorous, feeding on crustaceans and fish, and can be used as food.

Scarlet Waxy Cap (scientific name: Hygrocybe coccinea), also known as Scarlet Hood, Scarlet Waxcap, or Righteous Red Waxy Cap, is a brightly colored fungus of the Basidiomycota phylum, belonging to the genus Hygrocybe. This fungus is widely distributed in the northern hemisphere, east to China and Japan, west to the UK and the US, where traces of Scarlet Waxy Cap can be found. This bright red mushroom grows in late summer and autumn, with a cap diameter of 0.4–1 cm, and has a stem.

The Fine-spotted Moray, also known as Fine-spotted Moray, Fine-spotted Double Plow Moray, Money Eel, Potato Eel, Tiger Eel, is one of the species of the Moray family under the order of Anguilliformes, suborder of Muraenoidei, class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Indian Pacific region, from East Africa to the Galapagos Islands, north to the Ryukyu Islands, and south to the Australian waters. It inhabits at a depth of 5-100 meters and can grow up to 140 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in the intertidal zone with rocky substrates. It is carnivorous, feeding on crustaceans and fish. It can be used as a food fish, and there are reports of ciguatera poisoning.

Hymenogaster albus, also known as White Roundhead Umbrella, is a type of basidiomycete belonging to the genus Hymenogaster of the family Hymenogastraceae in the order Agaricales. The species epithet "albus" means "white". This species is distributed in China, Australia, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, Germany, Italy, Spain, Sweden, North America, South America, Africa, and other places.

The Purplemouth Moray, also known as the Purplemouth Conger, is a species of the Moray Eel family, which belongs to the order of Anguilliformes, suborder of Congroidei, and class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, from southern Florida in the United States to Brazil, and in the Eastern Atlantic region, including the Madeira Islands, Azores, Cape Verde Islands, Canary Islands, etc. It can inhabit depths of up to 145 meters and can grow up to 122 centimeters in length. It lives in coral reefs and rocky reef areas, feeds at night, and is carnivorous, feeding on fish and crustaceans. It can be used as food fish and ornamental fish.

The Light Moray, also known as the Light Moray Eel, is one of the species of the Moray Eel family in the suborder of Moray under the order of Anguilliformes in the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the Eastern Pacific region, from Mexico to the waters of Peru, inhabiting depths of 18-60 meters. It can reach a length of 120 centimeters, is a bottom-dwelling fish, living in rocky seabed areas, usually hiding in rock crevices and caves. It is carnivorous, its habits are unknown, and it can be used as a food fish.
Cephalanthera, also known as Jinlan genus, is a branch of the Orchidaceae family. There are about 15 species in the Cephalanthera genus, which are native to Europe, Asia, and North America.

The Brazilian Pike Cichlid is one of the species of the Cichlidae family in the suborder of Cichlasomatinae, order of Perciformes, and class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the freshwater areas of Ceará, Paraíba, Rio Grande do Norte, and Pernambuco in Brazil, South America. It can reach a length of 7.8 cm and inhabits the middle layer of river bottoms. Its habits are unknown.

The Suriname Spear Cichlid is one of the species of the Cichlidae family in the suborder of Cichlasomatinae, order of Perciformes, and class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Coppename River and the Saramacca River basin in Suriname, South America. It can reach a length of 17.9 cm and inhabits the middle layer of the river bottom. Its habits are unknown.

tail.text: Coppename River and the Saramacca River basin in Suriname, South America

text: The Green-buttocked Hidden Beautiful Fish, a species of the Pomacentridae family in the suborder of the Perciformes order of the Actinopterygii class, is distributed in the Guarumo River basin in Central America, Panama. It can reach a length of 6.4 cm and inhabits the middle and bottom waters, but its habits are unknown.

tail.text: Guarumo River basin in Central America, Panama

text: The Cottus genus, a genus of the Cottidae family, contains 68 species, described by Carl Linnaeus in 1758, and is widely distributed in the freshwater areas of the Paleartic and Nearctic regions. Its size is not large, rarely exceeding 15 cm (6 inches).

Eurotium cristatum, also known as the crown protruding sac fungus, is a type of fungus that belongs to the sac fungus genus of the Ascomycetes family. It can grow on substrates such as soil, brick tea, cordyceps, Chinese medicine tablets, and sawdust. This species is distributed in China, South Africa, Israel, Switzerland, the United Kingdom, and the United States. The crown protruding sac fungus is the sexual type of Aspergillus cristatellus.

The Spotted Naked-breast Eel, also known as the Spotted Naked-breast Conger, is one of the species of the Conger eel family in the suborder of Conger, order of Anguilliformes, class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Western Pacific region of India, including the waters of the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, etc. The habitat depth can reach 264 meters, the body length can reach 50.5 centimeters, it is a benthic fish, carnivorous, and its living habits are unknown.

Aspergillus granulosus, also known as granular aspergillus, is a type of fungus belonging to the Aspergillus genus of the Trichocomaceae family in the Eurotiales order. It can grow on substrates such as soil. This species is distributed in China, the United States, Costa Rica, Liberia, Pakistan, and other places.

Yunnan Meliola (scientific name: Meliola yunnanensis) is a kind of fungus belonging to the order of Meliola, the family of Meliola, and the genus of Meliola. It parasitizes on plants of the genus Trema. This species is distributed in China. The species epithet yunnanensis means "of Yunnan".

The White-cheeked Sparrow-Lark (scientific name: Eremopterix leucopareia) is a species of the Sparrow-Lark genus in the Lark family, distributed in Malawi, Kenya, Tanzania, Zambia, Burundi, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, and Uganda. The global activity range is about 748,000 square kilometers. The conservation status of this species is rated as non-endangered. The average weight of the White-cheeked Sparrow-Lark is about 14.5 grams. Habitats include subtropical or tropical (lowland) dry grasslands and farmland.

The South China Sea Myxidium (scientific name: Myxidium nanhaiensis) is an animal of the Myxidium genus of the Myxidium family. In China, it is distributed in Guangdong and other places, living a parasitic life, parasitizing in the gallbladder of carp.

Myxobolus pyramidis, also known as the tower-shaped iodine bubble worm, is an animal of the iodine bubble worm genus in the iodine bubble family. In China, it is distributed in Liaoning and other places, leading a parasitic life, parasitizing in the gills of crucian carp.

The Turbot is one of the species of the family Scophthalmidae, under the order Pleuronectiformes and suborder Pleuronectoidei of the class Actinopterygii. It is a tropical marine fish, distributed in the Eastern Atlantic region, from Mauritania to Angola, including the Mediterranean Sea, with a habitat depth of 15-400 meters. It can grow up to 45 centimeters in length, inhabiting the bottom waters with sandy and muddy substrates. It feeds on small fish and invertebrates. The breeding season is from May to August. Its habits are unknown. It can be used as food and ornamental fish.

Nepenthes bellii, also known as Bell's Pitcher Plant, is a tropical carnivorous plant endemic to the islands of Mindanao and Dinagat. It grows at altitudes from 0 to 800 meters. The species epithet is named after the American botanist Clyde Ritchie Bell.

The Red Fox (scientific name: Vulpes vulpes) is actually not certain whether it is distributed in Vietnam, and there are only a very small number of records on the border between Northern Vietnam and China.

The Peruvian angelfish, a species of the family Pomacanthidae under the suborder Labroidei of the order Perciformes of the class Actinopterygii, is distributed in Peru and the western Amazon basin of Brazil in South America. It can reach a length of 14.8 centimeters and inhabits the middle layer of river bottoms, but its habits are unknown.

The Indian Candlefish (scientific name: Polyipnus indicus) is one of the species of the Sternoptychidae family in the order of Stomiiformes of the class Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the Eastern African waters of the Western Indian Ocean region, is a deep-sea fish, inhabits depths of 50-500 meters, and performs vertical migration. Its body length can reach 6 centimeters.

tail.text: Eastern African waters of the Western Indian Ocean region

text: The Carp Iodine Protozoan (scientific name: Myxobolus cyprini) is an animal of the Iodine Protozoan family. It is distributed in Germany, Austria, Russia, India, and Liaoning, Shandong, Hunan, Hubei, Zhejiang, Jiangxi, Wuling Mountain area, Heilongjiang River Basin, etc., living a parasitic life, parasitizing in the spleen, gall, intestine, kidney of carp and silver carp, liver, heart of catfish, bladder of silver carp, gills of green fish, and intestines of red carp.

The Huamei Nanli fish, one of the species of the Pomacentridae family of the Perciformes order of the Actinopterygii class, is distributed in the freshwater areas of Uruguay to Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil, and the Parana River in South America. It can grow up to 19.3 cm in length, inhabits the middle and bottom water areas, and is omnivorous, feeding on plant debris, small fish, and insects. The female fish lay eggs on rocks or wood, and the adult fish will protect the young fish. It can be used as an ornamental fish.

tail.text: Uruguay to Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil

text: The genus Chrysolophus, commonly known as the pheasant, is a genus in the family Phasianidae in bird classification. It includes two species: the Red-bellied Pheasant and the White-bellied Pheasant, both of which are native to China. Currently, they are bred worldwide. The male pheasant has colorful and vibrant feathers, mainly living in dense coniferous forests, and is very difficult to observe in the wild. They mainly feed on grains, leaves, and invertebrates, and nest in the forest at night. Pheasants mainly run, and can reach high speeds when frightened.

Natal Left Flounder is one of the species of the family Pleuronectidae, belonging to the order Pleuronectiformes, suborder Pleuronectoidei, and class Actinopterygii. It is a deep-sea fish, distributed in the Natal waters of the South African Western Indian Ocean, with a habitat depth of 330-420 meters. It can grow up to 14 centimeters in length, inhabits the bottom waters, and feeds on benthic organisms. Its habits are unknown.

tail.text: Natal waters of the South African Western Indian Ocean

text: The Feathered Flounder is one of the species of the Diamond Flounder family, which belongs to the suborder of Flounder, the order of Flounder, and the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the Western Pacific region of India, including the waters of Australia and New Zealand, with a habitat depth of 120-900 meters. It can grow up to 20 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish and is carnivorous. Its living habits are unknown.

Dacrymyces enatus, also known as the elongated jelly fungus, is a type of fungus belonging to the Dacrymyces genus of the Dacrymycetaceae family in the Dacrymycetales order. It grows on the barkless decaying wood of broad-leaved trees. This species is distributed in China, Brazil, Finland, Russia, the United Kingdom, France, and the United States, among other places.

The Rain-spotted Naked-breast Eel, also known as the Rain-spotted Naked-breast Moray, is one of the species of the Moray family in the suborder of Moray under the order of Anguilliformes of the class of Actinopterygii. It is distributed in the waters of Mauritius in the Western Indian Ocean. It is a benthic fish and is carnivorous. Its habits are unknown.

tail.text: the waters of Mauritius in the Western Indian Ocean

text: Primula flabellifera, commonly known as Fan-leaved Primrose, is a species under the genus Primula in the family Primulaceae. It grows on alpine grassy slopes and rocks at altitudes of 4700-5000 meters.

tail.text: alpine grassy slopes and rocks at altitudes of 4700-5000 meters

text: Dacrymyces duii, also known as Du's Wood Ear, is a type of fungus belonging to the genus of Wood Ear in the family of Wood Ear under the order of Wood Ear. It grows on the cross-section of decayed birch wood. This species is distributed in China.

Taihangia rupestris var.ciliata, also known as the Ciliate Taihangia, is a variant of the Taihangia genus in the Rosaceae family. They are endemic to China and are distributed in Wu'an, Hebei. Their habitat is located on the shady slopes and cliff rocks at an altitude of 1000-1200 meters.

The Black-faced Munia (scientific name: Erythrura kleinschmidti) is a species of finch found on Viti Levu Island in Fiji. It is mainly distributed in the uninhabited mature forests in the central and eastern regions of Viti Levu Island. The conservation status of this species has been rated as vulnerable.

tail.text: the central and eastern regions of Viti Levu Island

text: The White Spot Pike Cichlid is one of the species of the Cichlidae family, under the order of Perciformes and suborder of Labroidei. It is distributed in the Demerara River in Guyana, South America and the Approuague River basin in French Guiana. It can grow up to 14 centimeters in length and inhabits slow-flowing streams with sandy and muddy bottoms covered with vegetation. Its habits are unknown.

tail.text: Demerara River in Guyana, South America

text: The Chestnut Moray, also known as the Chestnut Hookjaw Moray, is one of the species of the Moray Eel family in the suborder of Moray and the order of Eel. It is distributed in the Western Atlantic region, from the Bermuda Islands, southern Florida in the United States to the waters of Brazil. It inhabits at a depth of 1-20 meters and can grow up to 34 centimeters in length. It is a bottom-dwelling fish that lives in coral reef areas. It is carnivorous, but its habits are unknown.

The high-eyed beautiful body fish is one of the species of the Pomacentridae family of the Perciformes order of the Actinopterygii class, distributed in the freshwater and brackish water basins of the Atlantic coast of Central America from Mexico to Nicaragua. It can reach a length of 39.4 cm, inhabits swamps and mangroves, can tolerate changes in salinity, is carnivorous, feeds on fish and invertebrates, and can be used as food fish, ornamental fish, and farmed fish.

tail.text: Atlantic coast of Central America from Mexico to Nicaragua

text: Aspergillus aureolatus, also known as 具黄曲霉 in Chinese, is a type of fungus belonging to the Aspergillus genus of the Ascomycota order and the Aspergillaceae family. It can grow on substrates such as cotton yarn, kerosene storage tanks, and air. This species is distributed in China, Yugoslavia, and other places.

The Garnet Pitta (scientific name: Erythropitta granatina) is a species of the genus Erythropitta in the Pittidae family, distributed in Brunei, Myanmar, Singapore (extinct), Thailand, Indonesia, and Malaysia. The average weight of the Garnet Pitta is about 54.0 grams. Its habitats include subtropical or tropical swamp forests, subtropical or tropical moist lowland forests, and subtropical or tropical severely degraded former forests.

The Viosca's moray, also known as Viosca's naked chest moray, is one of the species of the Moray eel family in the suborder of Conger eel under the order of Anguilliformes in the class of Ray-finned fish. It is distributed in the Middle Eastern Pacific region, from the southern part of the Gulf of California to the waters of Peru, with a habitat depth of up to 10 meters and a body length of up to 43 centimeters. It is a benthic fish and carnivorous, but its living habits are unknown.
Yunnan Tofu Firewood (scientific name: Premna yunnanensis) is a species under the genus Tofu Firewood of the Verbenaceae family. Its species epithet yunnanensis means "of Yunnan".

The genus Oedipoda, also known as the band-winged grasshopper, is a model genus of the subfamily of band-winged grasshoppers in the family of sword-horned grasshoppers of the order Orthoptera, distributed in Europe, North Africa, Asia, and Oceania.

The Thayeria boehlkei, a species of the family Characidae in the suborder Characoidei of the order Perciformes in the class Actinopterygii, is distributed in the Tietê River and Paraná River basin in Brazil, South America. It can reach a length of 7.9 cm, inhabits the middle and bottom water layers, and its habits are unknown.

tail.text: the Tietê River and Paraná River basin in Brazil

text: The King Atherinomorus Regina (scientific name: Atherinomorus regina) is one of the species of the Atherinidae family, distributed in the waters of the Culion and Busuanga islands in the Western Pacific Philippines. It can grow up to 7 centimeters long, is a tropical fish, and lives in shallow coastal waters. Its habits are unknown.

The genus Gallus (scientific name: Gallus) is a genus of the Phasianidae family in the order Galliformes, which are larger birds. The male birds have rich and colorful feathers, distributed in India, Sri Lanka and Southeast Asia, including four species, among which the junglefowl is considered to be the likely ancestor of today's chickens.

Myxidium odontobutis, also known as the sand gudgeon myxosporean, is an animal of the Myxidium genus in the Myxidiidae family. In China, it is distributed in areas such as Zhejiang, leading a parasitic life, parasitizing in the bladder and hindgut of the sand gudgeon.

The Mexican Tetra, a species of the family Characidae in the suborder Characoidei of the order Perciformes of the class Actinopterygii, is distributed in the freshwater areas of Belize and Mexico in Central America. It can reach a length of 9.7 cm, inhabits the middle and bottom water layers, and its habits are unknown.

The Cocos Island flathead is one of the species of the family Platycephalidae, a tropical marine fish, distributed in the western Indian Pacific region, from Mozambique to Fiji, north to Japan, and south to the waters of Queensland, Australia. It inhabits depths of 1-30 meters and can reach a length of 12 centimeters. It inhabits clear water, sandy lagoons, and coral reef areas, but its habits are unknown.

The Hardhead Mojarra (scientific name: Atherinomorus stipes) is one of the species of the Mojarra family, distributed in the western Atlantic Bahamas, the Yucatan Peninsula of Mexico to the waters of Brazil, with a body length of up to 10 cm. It is a tropical fish, living in coastal sandy and coral reef shallow waters, feeding on plankton, and its habits are unknown.
The Red-eared Parrotfinch (scientific name: Erythrura coloria) is a type of Munia, endemic to the island of Mindanao in the Philippines.

tail.text: island of Mindanao in the Philippines

text: Asteridiella melastomatacearum, also known as Wild Peony Small Light Shell, is a type of fungus belonging to the genus of Small Light Shell in the family of Small Coal Shell under the order of Small Coal Shell. It parasitizes on plants of the Wild Peony family. This species is distributed in China, Brazil, Paraguay, Panama, Uganda, Jamaica, Ecuador, Cuba, Guyana, Argentina, Venezuela, Puerto Rico, Honduras, the United States, Bolivia, the Philippines, Sierra Leone, and other places.

The Long-arm Left Flounder is one of the species of the Pleuronectidae family, a deep-sea fish, distributed in the Western Indian Ocean Kenya, Mozambique, South African waters, living at a depth of 180-310 meters, can reach a length of 19 centimeters, inhabits the bottom waters, feeds on benthic organisms, and its habits are unknown.

Bhutan Campion (Scientific name: Silene indica var.bhutanica) is a variety under the genus Campion of the family Caryophyllaceae. The species epithet "indica" means "of India". The variety epithet "bhutanica" means "of Bhutan".

The Hejiang Myxidium (scientific name: Myxidium hokiangensis) is an animal of the Myxidium genus in the Myxidium family. In China, it is distributed in Sichuan and other places, living a parasitic life, parasitizing in the gallbladder of yellow-headed fish and Chinese stickleback.
Yunnan Tarenna (scientific name: Tarenna yunnanensis) is a species under the genus Tarenna of the Rubiaceae family. Its species epithet yunnanensis means "of Yunnan".

Myxidium nasali, also known as the nasal myxidium, is an animal of the Myxidium genus in the Myxidium family. In China, it is distributed in places like Sichuan and lives a parasitic life, parasitizing in the nasal cavity of perch.

Utricularia foliosa, also known as leafy bladderwort, is a large, floating, carnivorous plant of the bladderwort genus, suspected to be perennial. The species epithet "foliosa" comes from the Latin "folium", meaning "leaf". Leafy bladderwort is distributed in Africa, North America, and South America.

The Short-toed Lark (scientific name: Calandrella somalica) is a species of the lark family, genus Short-toed Lark. It is a migratory bird that hunts and distributes in Somalia, Kenya, Tanzania, and Ethiopia. The global activity range is about 298,000 square kilometers. The conservation status of this species has been rated as non-endangered. The habitat of the Short-toed Lark is subtropical or tropical (lowland) dry grassland.

Mulberry orange is native to the central United States, including a narrow strip in the southwest of Arkansas, southeast of Oklahoma, east of Texas, and northwest corner of Louisiana. It has been introduced and cultivated in places like Dalian, Liaoning and Qinhuangdao, Hebei in China.

The Striped Single Armor South Milkfish, one of the species of the South Milkfish family in the Cucumber Fish order of the Ray-finned Fish class, is distributed in the freshwater and brackish water areas from Villarrica Lake in Chile, South America to Lacar Lake in Argentina and Tierra del Fuego. It can grow up to 33.4 cm in length, is carnivorous, mainly lives in lakes, and its habits are unknown.

tail.text: Villarrica Lake in Chile, South America

text: The Pin-tailed Parrotfinch (scientific name: Erythrura hyperythra) is a common munia found in Indonesia, Malaysia, and the Philippines. Its global activity range is approximately 1,000,000 to 10,000,000 square kilometers. The Pin-tailed Parrotfinch is distributed in subtropical and tropical mountainous wet forests. The conservation status of this species has been rated as non-endangered.

The Red-faced Crimson-wing (scientific name: Cryptospiza reichenovii) is a common finch in Africa. Its global distribution range is about 390,000 square kilometers. The Red-faced Crimson-wing is distributed in Angola, Burundi, Cameroon, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Malawi, Mozambique, Niger, Nigeria, Rwanda, Tanzania, Uganda, Zambia, and Zimbabwe.

Eurotium echinulatum, also known as the spore sac fungus, is a type of fungus belonging to the genus of sac fungi in the family of Ascomycetes. It can grow on substrates such as soil, cow dung, and figs. This species is distributed in China, the United States, the Netherlands, Norway, Spain, the United Kingdom, and the former Yugoslavia. The spore sac fungus is the sexual type of Aspergillus brunneus.

The Spectacled owl (scientific name: Pulsatrix perspicillata), a nocturnal bird of prey in the tropical American forest area of the order Strigiformes and family Strigidae. The young birds are white with a black face disk. The adult bird is about 50 centimeters long; the upper body is brown, the lower body is lighter, and the chest is also brown. The face is brown with white eyebrows.

The Humpback South Beauty Fish (scientific name: Australoheros scitulus) is one of the species of the Cichlidae family, distributed in the La Plata River Basin in Uruguay, South America. It can reach a length of 8.9 cm, inhabits in flowing waters with sandy and rocky bottoms, and its habits are unknown. The species epithet "scitulus" means "beautiful".

tail.text: La Plata River Basin in Uruguay, South America

text: The Borneo Pitcher Plant is a vine plant that can grow up to 2.5 meters, and at most up to 10 meters. The stem can branch, often clinging to the surrounding vegetation, but can also grow creeping on the ground. The stem is cylindrical or slightly angular, with a diameter of up to 5 millimeters, and the internode distance can reach 2 centimeters. No subspecies of the Borneo Pitcher Plant have been found yet.

Adenanthum Rhododendron (scientific name: Rhododendron adenanthum) is a species under the genus Rhododendron of the Rhododendron family.

The Cephalocarida (scientific name: Cephalocarida) is a class of shrimp-like animals under the subphylum Crustacea. They were first discovered in 1955 and were initially classified within the class Copepoda. Although no fossils of the Cephalocarida have ever been found, most scholars believe that they are primitive crustaceans.

Wendlandia pubigera, commonly known as the large-leaved magnolia, is a species under the genus Wendlandia of the Rubiaceae family.

Athyrium melanolepis, commonly known as Black Scale Cloak Fern, is a species under the genus of Cloak Fern in the family of Cloak Fern.
Lobophytum mirabile, commonly known as the leafy soft coral, is a species under the genus of leafy soft corals in the family of soft corals.

The Black Tide Cowrie (scientific name: Palmadusta contaminata) is a species of sea snail, a gastropod mollusk in the family Cypraeidae. It was formerly classified under the genus Cypraea, but now belongs to the genus Palmadusta.
Shishan Tofu Firewood (scientific name: Premna crassa) is a species under the genus Tofu Firewood of the Verbenaceae family.
The superfamily Gelechioidea is a taxonomic unit at the superfamily level under the order Lepidoptera. This superfamily has high species diversity, with over 18,000 species described so far.
Glyceria lithuanica, commonly known as Two-stamen Sweet Grass, is a species of plant under the genus Glyceria of the family Poaceae.

Marsh Woundwort (scientific name: Stachys palustris) is a species under the genus of Woundwort in the family Lamiaceae.

Maytenus garanbiensis, commonly known as the Shiny Leaf Mayten, is a species under the Maytenus genus of the Celastraceae family.

Shiluzhu (scientific name: Phyllostachys arcana) is a species under the genus Phyllostachys of the family Poaceae.
Beilschmiedia glauca var.glaucoides, commonly known as Dingxu Qiongnan, is a variety under the genus Beilschmiedia of the Lauraceae family.

Leishan Rhododendron (scientific name: Rhododendron leishanicum) is a species under the genus Rhododendron of the Rhododendron family.

Leucopoa sclerophylla, commonly known as the hard-leaved silver spike grass, is a plant species under the genus Leucopoa of the family Poaceae.

Multilobed glandular fly grass (scientific name: Silene yetii var.herbilegorum) is a variant under the genus of fly grass in the Caryophyllaceae family.
Sinosenecio subcoriaceus, commonly known as Leatherleaf Scorpionweed, is a species under the genus of Scorpionweed in the Asteraceae family.
Black Madder (scientific name: Rubia mandersii) is a plant species under the genus Rubia of the family Rubiaceae.
Thin-leaved Primrose (scientific name: Primula membranifolia) is a species under the genus Primula of the Primulaceae family.
Strophioblachia fimbricalyx, commonly known as Strophioblachia, is a species of plant in the genus Strophioblachia of the Euphorbiaceae family.

Pinguicula villosa, commonly known as the northern butterwort, is a species under the genus Pinguicula of the family Lentibulariaceae.
The Black-footed Aoria nigripes, a species under the genus of Aoria, belongs to the family of Chrysomelidae. The specific epithet "nigripes" means "black-footed".
Variegated peach is a kind of peach plant in Beijing Botanical Garden. The Prunus genus includes species such as black cherry, Chinese apricot, and peach.
White-backed Yushania (scientific name: Yushania glauca) is a species under the genus Yushania of the family Poaceae.
Kobresia seticulmis, commonly known as the stiff sedge, is a species under the genus Kobresia of the family Cyperaceae.
The genus Dynomene (Dynomene) is a branch of the subfamily of Dynomenidae, which belongs to the superfamily of sponge crabs, and was discovered in 1823. The type genus is: D.hispida.
Mimi is a cute American Shorthair cat, and the cat breeds include shorthair cats, longhair cats, tabby cats, Persian cats, etc.
Spiradiclis baishaiensis, commonly known as Baise snail order grass, is a species under the genus of snail order grass in the Rubiaceae family.

Gastrodia angusta, commonly known as Yuan Tianma, is a species under the genus Gastrodia of the Orchidaceae family.
Polygala persicariifolia, commonly known as Persicaria-leaved Milkwort, is a species under the genus Polygala of the family Polygalaceae.
Sikkim Red Silk Thread (Scientific name: Lycianthes macrodon var.sikkimensis) is a variety under the genus of Red Silk Thread of the Solanaceae family.
Longshan Rhododendron (scientific name: Rhododendron chunii) is one or two species under the genus Rhododendron of the Rhododendron family.
West Mountain Silver Spike Grass (Scientific name: Leucopoa olgae) is a plant species under the Silver Spike Grass genus of the Poaceae family.
Tabu (scientific name: Sabina chinensis cv.Pyramidalis) is a variety/cultivation type under the genus Sabina of the cypress family.
Caragana rosea, also known as Red Flower Caragana, is a plant species belonging to the genus Caragana of the Fabaceae family.
Big Mouse Ear (scientific name: Berchemia hirtella var.glabrescens) is a variant under the genus Berchemia of the Rhamnaceae family.
The Silver-capped Fruit Dove (scientific name: Ptilinopus richardsii) is a species of bird in the pigeon family, Columbidae, of the order Columbiformes.

The genus Callinectes, also known as the beautiful green crab, is a genus of the family Portunidae, and the blue crab belongs to this genus. The species under it have a pair of flat walking legs, a flat and wide carapace, and teeth at the front end of the carapace, near the eyes, and at the rear end. The largest tooth is located between the eyes. The back of the beautiful green crab genus is generally olive green or blue, the bottom is white, and there are blue or red places on the thin claws. The size and color of the claws of some species vary.

Bashu people, commonly known as Sichuan people, are sometimes also called Chuan people or Chuan-Yu people, and very few are called Bashu people. It refers to the local people in Sichuan and Chongqing areas now or in the past, most of whom now use Sichuan dialect as their first or second mother tongue, have a unique sense of identity , and identify with Bashu culture. The Bashu people originated from the non-Huaxia tribes of the Shu and Ba tribes, and after a long history of population migration, they finally formed after the two major immigration movements of "Huguang Filling Sichuan" in the early Ming and early Qing dynasties. The current total population is about 120 million, making it one of the most populous groups among the Han Chinese.

Sony Pictures Entertainment Inc., also known as Sony Pictures or Sony Film, is an American media entertainment company that produces and distributes films and television. It is a member of the Motion Picture Association of America, one of the five major film companies in the United States, and is the fifth highest entertainment company in the world, following The Walt Disney Company, Comcast Group, Warner Bros. Discovery, and Paramount Global.

Shenyang Bawangsi Beverage Co., Ltd., commonly known as Bawangsi Soda Factory or Bawangsi Soda, is a beverage production company founded in 1920. The American Statistical Association , is the most important organization established for statistics and related professions in the United States. The Statistical Association mainly provides services for statisticians, econometricians, and other scientists closely related to statistical needs.

The Eritrea National Olympic Committee is the National Olympic Committee of Eritrea. The organization was established in 1996 and is a member of the International Olympic Committee and the Association of National Olympic Committees of Africa. Currently, the headquarters of the Eritrea National Olympic Committee is located in the capital Asmara, and the chairman is Mr Mehari Tesfai.

Yu's Private Primary School, originally located at Xue Street Zaojun Temple in Baodi District, Tianjin, was founded in 1928 with the support of the then county magistrate Jing Renxu, by Yu Yiyuan and Zhang Junling. It was the first private primary school in Baodi District, admitting both male and female students. The top three students in the exam were exempted from tuition fees. In addition to the normal curriculum similar to that of national primary schools, it also offered courses in ancient texts, bamboo slips, and abacus. Initially, there was only one junior class, but in 1929, a senior primary school class was added, and later it developed into four classes with more than 120 students. Due to conflicts with the national primary school, it was ordered to be closed by the Hebei Provincial Department of Education in 1935. Aristotle's "Poetics" discusses the issue of repetition of tragedy and comedy.

An excessively high content of pregnanetriol in urine tests may be related to congenital adrenal hyperplasia. It can be used as an indirect method to measure the level of progesterone in the body.

The unit of electric energy is "joule", abbreviated as "joule", represented by the Latin letter J. Electric energy is equal to the integral of active power over time. Because the unit joule is very small and inconvenient to use in life and production, people use a larger energy unit than joule - kilowatt-hour , the symbol of kilowatt is kW·h. The conversion formula between the unit joule of electric energy and kilowatt-hour is: 1 kilowatt-hour = 3.6×106 joules.

Allura Red AC, also known as Temptation Red, is a red azo dye, also known as FD&C Red40 in the United States. It is used as a food coloring, with the E code E129. It is usually provided in the form of red sodium salt, but can also be used as calcium salt and potassium salt. These salts are soluble in water. In solution, its maximum absorbance is at about 504nm.

Red flower seeds, is one of the local snacks in Yichang, Hubei, Yichang dialect calls it "porcelain doll", like cold shrimp, often used as a summer drink. The method of making red flower seeds is to filter out the juice from a local seed called "red flower seeds" (the real name is "Xili") and add a small amount of water, stir well and add a small amount of lime to clarify, take the upper clear layer and freeze it overnight, when it becomes jelly-like, it is done. It can be mixed with brown sugar water for consumption. The red flower seeds seen on the street are mostly red because of the brown sugar water, and when the red flower seeds are made into a gel, they are colorless.

Mayonnaise (French: mayonnaise), also known as egg yolk sauce, is a thick semi-solid sauce made mainly from vegetable oil, eggs, lemon juice or vinegar, and other seasonings. It is generally divided into two methods: using only egg yolk and using whole eggs. Egg yolk sauce is a type of salad dressing, but not all salad dressings are egg yolk sauce. Egg yolk sauce is often used in salads, sandwiches and other dishes. The traditional shops in Chiayi, Taiwan, usually drizzle a salad dressing called white vinegar on the cold noodles they sell. Some people think that it is egg yolk sauce, but its taste is different from that of egg yolk sauce.

Cucumber yogurt sauce, literally translated as Tzatziki, is a kind of sauce in Greek dietary culture. It is a kind of dip originated from the Ottoman Empire, using cucumber (pickles) and yogurt (whey yogurt) made from sheep's milk (sheep's milk or goat's milk). It is often seen in appetizers and is considered a healthy alternative to mayonnaise, which can be used to spread bread (including pita bread). Tzatziki is usually made from Greek yogurt and cucumber, garlic, salt, olive oil, red wine vinegar, and dill. American-style Tzatziki may also add lemon juice, mint, or coriander. Dishes similar to Tzatziki include buttermilk soup.

A pressure regulator is a device that automatically adjusts the outlet pressure of a fluid to stabilize it within a certain pressure range. It is usually a valve that operates on its own and maintains a constant controlled pressure, relying solely on the energy of the controlled fluid, so it is also known as a pressure regulating valve or a pressure reducing valve. In practical applications, pressure regulators are often used in gas pipelines. They are a special type of valve that can reduce the upstream gas pressure in the pipeline to a certain pressure and output it to the downstream valve. A gas pressure regulator is also a self-powered pressure regulating valve, which does not require an external power source.

Corn dog is a kind of food made by wrapping a hot dog in a cornmeal batter and deep frying it, originated in the United States, and is usually served with ketchup. Originally, corn dogs were not skewered, but now they are almost always skewered for easy eating. The hot dogs used in corn dogs are usually mass-produced pink, with a very ordinary meaty texture, and the coating can usually increase the volume of the entire hot dog by nearly double. Due to its low cost and easy production, corn dogs are usually sold at night markets and tourist attractions.

The Harmony 3C type electric locomotive  is one of the electric locomotive models of China Railway, developed and manufactured by China North Vehicle Group Dalian Locomotive & Vehicle Co., Ltd. It is a high-power AC transmission mainline passenger and freight common electric locomotive developed and manufactured based on the HXD3 type electric locomotive design and manufacturing technology platform, and has borrowed the mature technology of the HXD3B type electric locomotive. Its continuous power is 7200kW, the maximum running speed is 120km/h, and it has a 600V DC train power supply system and a dual-tube air supply device.

China Coast Guard 3210, formerly known as China Fisheries Law Enforcement 310, was designed by the 701 Institute Shanghai Branch and built by the Guangdong Zhanjiang Seaside Shipyard. It was launched on the morning of March 6, 2010, at the Guangdong Zhanjiang Seaside Shipyard, underwent sea trials in July, and officially entered service in November. It is the flagship of the China South Sea Fisheries Law Enforcement Fleet. It is also a Chinese law enforcement official ship of over 2000 tons equipped with armed organ guns.

Miniature submarines, also known as pocket submarines, are a type of submarine that are small in size, carry few crew members, and have a displacement of less than 100 tons. Miniature submarines are mainly used in military, security, research, and exploration. Although miniature submarines have weak firepower, they can support special operations and assist other submarines or ships in resupplying, such as the submarines used by special forces on the American Virginia-class submarines.

The DF11G type internal combustion locomotive, also known as DF11G, is a double-engine heavy-duty quasi-high-speed internal combustion locomotive model used by China Railway. It was specially developed by CRRC Qishuyan Locomotive Co., Ltd. for the fifth major speed increase of China Railway. Its design draws on the technology of the DF11 and DF11Z locomotives, and can meet the application conditions of single-driver shift operation and long-distance continuous operation, and has the function of supplying power to passenger cars. It is also the first internal combustion locomotive in China to adopt full microcomputer control technology.

head.text: The DF11G type internal combustion locomotive
The DF11G type internal combustion locomotive

text: A bread machine  is a machine for making bread. After the user puts the bread-making ingredients into the bread machine, the bread machine will automatically complete the kneading, fermentation and baking, the three main procedures for making bread. After the user opens the lid of the bread machine, they can take out the freshly baked bread. Most bread machines are built-in with microcomputers, allowing the bread-making process to be automated, so it is also called an "automatic bread maker". Although this automatic bread-making machine has had different Chinese names in the past, it is now most commonly known as "bread machine" in mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong and Macau regions.

tail.text: mainland China, Taiwan, and Hong Kong and Macau regions

text: A thermal airship is a type of airship that generates lift by heating the gas inside to reduce its density. Most of the existing thermal airships are filled with air, just like hot air balloons. Some thermal airships are designed to use gases lighter than air and heat a part of it  to increase additional lift. The first well-known thermal airship was the Cameron D-96, made by Don Cameron, a British man, and was unveiled in 1973. It took 3 years to develop.

The jazz drum, usually referred to as the drum set, is a type of percussion art that appeared in the 1910s Dixieland jazz, 1970s jazz rock, 1980s Latin jazz and other modern jazz. The playing style of jazz drums is constantly updated under the influence of its origin in New Orleans and other regions in the United States, the Caribbean, and Africa. In addition, because jazz requires a more flexible and changeable form of percussion instruments different from traditional European music to adapt to the rhythm requirements of various new styles, the performance skills of jazz drums have also become more complex and changeable.

Polar fleece, also known as fleece, double-sided brushed cloth, or shaking velvet, is a soft, synthetic fiber fabric with a fluffy surface, made from Polyethylene terephthalate . The first polar fleece was invented by Malden Mills in 1979. Polar fleece has some of the advantages of wool, but is much lighter than wool.

The USS Wright , also known as the Wright aircraft carrier, is the second ship of the two Saipan-class aircraft carriers of the United States Navy. It was built during World War II, converted from a cruiser hull, and later converted into a command ship CC-2 due to the excessive number of larger tonnage aircraft carriers in the US Navy. The "Wright" is the second US warship with this name, the previous one was a supply ship , named after Orville Wright, the younger brother of the Wright brothers who invented the airplane, while this aircraft carrier was named after both brothers, Orville and Wilbur.

The USS Missouri BB-63 is a battleship belonging to the United States Navy, the third ship of the Iowa-class battleships. She is the third US military ship named after the state of Missouri, and also the last battleship built by the US Navy. She is the last battleship retired by the US in World War II, and is also famous for being designated as the surrender ship at the end of World War II.

Chaozhou wood carving, also known as Chaozhou gold lacquer wood carving, is a folk carving art popular in Chaozhou City, Shantou City, Jieyang City and other places in the former Chaozhou Prefecture of Guangdong Province. It is especially known for its multi-layered hollowing and golden lacquer wood carving. It is known as one of the four major wood carvings in China, along with Dongyang wood carving, boxwood carving, and longan wood carving. Chaozhou wood carving has a long history, developed during the Tang and Song dynasties, matured in the late Ming dynasty, and reached its peak in the middle and late Qing dynasty. On May 20, 2006, it was listed in the first batch of China's national intangible cultural heritage list.
Pancake balls, also known as apple slices, are a Danish snack.

The San Telmo , also known as the Saint Peter Gonzalez or the Saint Erasmus of Friesland, is a Spanish 74-gun sailing battleship launched in 1788. In 1819, the flagship San Telmo, led by Rosen Polirel, went to Peru's Cayao to suppress the Spanish American revolutionary movement, but was severely damaged by bad weather in the Drake Strait of Cape Horn and sank in September 1819. The 644 crew members on board were the first people to die in the Antarctic waters, and the shipwreck remains were found on Livingston Island.

"Untouchable Lovers" is a South Korean film produced in 2000, directed by Lee Hyun-seung, starring Lee Jung-jae and Jun Ji-hyun. The foreign name of the film, IL MARE, is Italian, meaning 'sea', which is also the name of the seaside cottage in the film story. The film tells a love story of a man and a woman separated by time and space, communicating through a mysterious mailbox. In 2006, Warner Bros. of the United States released a remake version called "The Lake House".

"The Great Doctor An Daoquan", also known as "The Copper Man of the Great Song", is a TV series set in the late Northern Song Dynasty, telling the legendary life of the Water Margin hero An Daoquan. It started shooting in November 2013, finished in January 2014, and premiered on Fujian TV Drama Channel on August 26, 2014.

Magnesium oxide , also known as magnesia, is an oxide of magnesium, an ionic compound; it is a white solid at room temperature; magnesium oxide exists in nature in the form of periclase.

Noble metal, also known as inert metal, is a metal with strong anti-oxidation and corrosion resistance, generally rare in the earth's crust; it includes some precious metals.
Nitrobenzene is the simplest aromatic nitro compound, with the chemical formula C6H5NO2. It was discovered by Mitschurich Ilhad in 1834.
Glyoxylic acid is composed of an aldehyde group  and a carboxyl group , its structural formula is HOCCOOH, and the molecular formula is C2H2O3.

Platinum monoxide , also known as monoplatinum oxide or platinum oxide, is a +2 valence oxide of platinum. In addition to platinum monoxide, there are also platinum dioxide and platinum trioxide among the oxides of platinum.
Gasoline, a kind of hydrocarbon mixture liquid with volatility and flammability, is distilled or cracked from petroleum and can be used as fuel. It is also known as "electric oil" in Hong Kong.
Thallium triiodide is an inorganic compound with the chemical formula TlI3. Unlike other thallium trihalides, thallium triiodide does not have thallium  ions, but it does have triiodide anions.

Radium chloride, with the chemical formula RaCl2, is the first radium compound to be produced, made by Marie Curie. Metallic radium was initially produced by electrolyzing radium chloride solution with a mercury electrode.

Among them, except for nitrogen pentoxide which is solid under normal conditions, other nitrogen oxides are gaseous under normal conditions. Nitrogen oxides (NOx) often refer to NO and NO2 as air pollutants.

Sodium benzoate is the sodium salt of benzoic acid, with the chemical formula C6H5CO2Na, and is a white crystalline solid. Sodium benzoate is a commonly used food preservative, with the E number E211.

text: ZiS-30 is a tank destroyer, also known as a tank destroyer, that the Soviet Union began to produce in 1941.

Wucheng Yuping Wine, also known as Yuping Wine and Xixian Yuping Wine, is a medicinal wine produced by Wucheng Winery in Xixian, Shanxi Province, People's Republic of China. It is a high-quality brand product in Shanxi Province.

Fairchild Swearingen Metroliner, also known as Fairchild Aerospace Metro, is a 19-seat twin-turboprop airliner produced by the Swearingen Aircraft Company, which was later produced by Fairchild Company after being acquired.

The Chinasat-20A communication broadcast satellite was launched and successfully entered the predetermined orbit at 0:09 on November 25, 2010, at the Xichang Satellite Launch Center in China. The rocket carrying it is the "Long March 3A". Chinasat-20A was mainly developed and produced by the China Academy of Launch Vehicle Technology, a subsidiary of the China Aerospace Science and Technology Corporation, and mainly provides services such as voice transmission, data, and broadcast television.

text: Pufferfish noodles, also known as pufferfish plain noodles, is a local cuisine widely distributed in the coastal areas of the Seto Inland Sea. Okayama Prefecture, Hiroshima Prefecture, Ehime Prefecture, and Oita Prefecture also have the same cuisine . The boiled pufferfish and cooked plain noodles are served together in a large bowl, and the soup used for boiling the pufferfish is also kept. The Nanyu region uses shredded eggs and shredded shiitake mushrooms as ingredients. In the flavored cuisine, green onions and shredded ginger are added.

tail.text: coastal areas of the Seto Inland Sea

text: Red food refers to food that is red, orange-red, or brown-red. Scientists believe that eating more red food can prevent colds. Eating chili soup can help patients with wind-cold type colds to sweat, which is beneficial to the recovery from a cold. Red carrots are beneficial for treating respiratory diseases, such as pharyngitis and laryngitis, and can also alleviate hoarseness.

China Science and Technology Network , with the autonomous system number AS7497, can be traced back to the Zhongguancun Education and Research Demonstration Network  established by the Chinese Academy of Sciences in August 1989. It is the first backbone network in China, and the first full-function connection with the international Internet in China was also achieved through this network.

The Javelin shoulder-fired anti-aircraft missile is the second generation of infantry anti-aircraft missiles that replaced the Blowpipe anti-aircraft missile in the UK after the Falklands War. In 1993, the British Army's Javelin missile was replaced by the Javelin S-15, commercially known as Starburst, and the Starlight missile in 1997.
A dress, also known as a western dress, a one-piece dress, or a robe dress, refers to a garment that connects the top and the skirt.
Yuzu tea, also known as yuzu honey, yuzu honey tea, honey yuzu tea, is a traditional Korean tea made from the oranges  and honey in the southern part of Korea.

"Korean turbid wine", also known as "farmer's wine", translated into Chinese as "Magli", is a kind of Korean turbid rice wine fermented from rice and wheat, with an alcohol content of 6-8%, and a sweet taste. The Magli produced in the season of pear blossom bloom has the flavor of pear blossom, so it is called "pear blossom wine". Koreans generally drink Magli when eating mung bean cakes or onion cakes.
Kevin ZP98  is a pocket-sized semi-automatic pistol produced in the Czech Republic, which is sold in the United States by Magnum Research Company under the name of Mini Desert Eagle .

Phenolic resin is a kind of synthetic plastic, a colorless or yellow-brown transparent solid, which is commonly used in electrical equipment and is also commonly known as Bakelite. It has excellent heat resistance, flame resistance, water resistance, and insulation, good acid resistance, poor alkali resistance, good mechanical and electrical properties, and is easy to cut. It is divided into thermosetting plastics and thermoplastics. By adding different components during synthesis, modified phenolic resins with different functions can be obtained, which have different excellent characteristics, such as alkali resistance, wear resistance, oil resistance, corrosion resistance, etc.

The Fokker F27 "Friendship" is a turboprop aircraft produced by the Dutch aircraft manufacturer Fokker. It is a small passenger aircraft of the 32-seat class, often used for regional or island routes with shorter distances.
Fire-control radar (English: fire-control radar, abbreviated: FCR) is a type of radar used to provide information to the fire control system to calculate the distance and angle of weapon launch.

Qingxin Oolong, also known as Zhongcha, Zhongzi, Ruanzhi Oolong, and Yu Cong, is one of the traditional tea tree varieties in Taiwan. The variety originated from Anxi, Fujian, China, and was bred in Taiwan. It can be used to make Taiwanese Oolong tea, Baozhong tea, or Oriental Beauty tea.

The VW166 amphibious vehicle (German: Volkswagen Typ166Schwimmwagen) was widely used by the German army during World War II. The designer was the famous Ferdinand Porsche, and it was produced by Volkswagen.
"Magic Warrior Levi" is a fantasy novel created by Japanese author Ryo Mizuno, and there are also animations and comics.

"The Goldfinch"  is an oil painting on panel, created by Dutch painter Carel Fabritius in 1654. The painting is 33.5 cm high and 22.8 cm wide, and is currently housed in the Mauritshuis Royal Art Museum in The Hague, Netherlands.

"Vinyl" (English: Vinyl) is an experimental American film directed by Andy Warhol in 1965, adapted from the novel "A Clockwork Orange" by Anthony Burgess, and accompanied by music such as "Nowhere to Run" by Martha and the Vandellas.

"Youth and the Countryside" is an article published by Li Dazhao in the "Morning Post" from February 20 to 23, 1919. It proposes that "if you want to infuse modern new civilization into society from the root, you must unite the intellectual class with the working class."

"Ancient and Modern Tea Affairs" is a collection of tea literature from China's Tang Dynasty to the Ming Dynasty, compiled by Hu Shanyuan, published by the World Book Bureau in 1941, and reprinted by the Shanghai Bookstore in 1985.
"Back to 1942" is a novella written and published by Chinese writer Liu Zhenyun, with the 1942 Henan famine as the theme. It was later adapted into the 2012 film "1942" by Feng Xiaogang.

text: Chicken McNuggets is a dish launched by the international fast food chain McDonald's in 1983 in its international franchise restaurants. It is a chicken product made by processing and stirring chicken into meat paste, then adding bread crumbs and frying it. Roughly speaking, 6 Chicken McNuggets have about 250 kilocalories. To this day, Chicken McNuggets are still one of the popular products in McDonald's food. Nugget means gold nugget, named after the Chicken McNuggets' shape similar to gold nuggets.

Although the reviews were mostly negative, it was still successful at the box office and became a classic for disaster film fans.

"A Young Doctor's Notebook" (English: A Young Doctor's Notebook) is a British black comedy television series, adapted from the works of Mikhail Afanasyevich Bulgakov. The two selves are played by Jon Hamm and Daniel Radcliffe respectively. The first and second seasons are each composed of 4 episodes, which were broadcast on Sky Arts in 2012 and 2013.

Globally, the film grossed $250 million .

It was released in mainland China on March 8, 2019. The most special stars are a group of cute pet dogs, including a champion dog.

"Never Here" is an American thriller film directed and written by Camille Thoman. The film stars Mireille Enos. It premiered at the Los Angeles Film Festival on June 18, 2017, and was distributed by Vertical Entertainment. This film is the last one that actor Sam Shepard appeared in.
The TV version of "With You" premiered in mainland China in 2004, directed by Meng Ji, starring Cheng Qian, Liu Peiqi, Wang Zhiwen, and Niu Li.

text: "3Nights in the Desert"  is a 2014 American drama film directed by Gabriel Cowan, written by Adam Chanzit, and starring Wes Bentley, Vincent Piazza, and Amber Tamblyn. The film premiered at the Palm Springs International Film Festival on January 4, 2014, and was subsequently screened at the Twin Cities Film Festival on October 18, 2014. The film had a limited release in early 2015.

"The Karate Kid" , a Hollywood movie produced by Will Smith in 2010, was adapted from the classic Hollywood movie "The Karate Kid" in 1984 by Will Smith who bought the copyright. Directed by Harold Zwart, starring Will Smith's son Jaden Smith, the main scenes were shot in Beijing. The film premiered in the United States on June 11, 2010, and won $55 million in the first week of release, becoming the box office champion of the week. It was released in China on June 22, with a box office of 25 million yuan in the first week.

"The Heiress" , a Chinese historical drama set in an imaginary past, was released in 2020. The drama, starring Jiang Chao, You Jingru, Wang Anyu, Tang Mengjia, Wu Yang, and Cao Li, was filmed from April to July in 2019. It premiered on Tencent Video on August 13, 2020.

"Huo Yuanjia" is a historical drama filmed and produced in 2007 based on the story of Chinese martial artist Huo Yuanjia, in which many characters including Chen Zhen are fictional. Directed by Ju Jueliang, starring Ekin Cheng, Jordan Chan, Zhou Muyin, Leung Ka Yan, Ding Li, and Qu Yue. The sequel to this drama, "Jingwu Chen Zhen", was aired in 2008.

"Ministers of Namsan" is a South Korean drama film released in 2020, starring Lee Byung-hun and others. This film represents South Korea in the competition for the Best International Film Award at the 93rd Academy Awards in 2021.
"The Divine Fury" is a South Korean horror film in 2019, directed by Kim Joo-hwan, starring Park Seo-joon, Ahn Sung-ki, and Woo Do-hwan.

"Visitors on the Iceberg" is a Chinese drama film released in 1963, produced by Changchun Film Studio, directed by Zhao Xinshui, scripted by Bai Xin, photographed by Zhang Hui, composed by Lei Zhenbang, and starred by Liang Yin, Abudulimiti and others. Its theme songs "Missing Comrades" and "Why are the Flowers So Red" are well-known.

"Superman" Clark Kent, played by Brandon Routh, appeared in the 2019 Arrowverse crossover episode "Crisis on Infinite Earths". This version of Superman is set on Earth-96, and the plot continues after the movie where Superman encounters the event of Kingdom Come.

"Journey with Zhou" is a new type of global outdoor lifestyle and culture reality show led by Jay Chou and his friends Du Guozhang, Chen Guanlin, and Cai Weize as regular guests. Netflix updates a new episode every Saturday at 22:00 from March 21, 2020; it premiered on Zhejiang Satellite TV in mainland China, with a new episode broadcast every Saturday at 22:00 from March 21, 2020, and the online streaming platform is Mango TV, with a total of 13 episodes for the whole season (12 episodes were broadcast on Zhejiang Satellite TV).

"Heart" is a morning serial drama  of NHK Japan in the first half of 2003. It is starred by Noriko Nakagoshi, and the background is set in Japan at the beginning of the 21st century. It was broadcast from March 31, 2003 to September 27, 2003.

"Consummation" is a youth campus suspense web drama starring Zhao Yiqin, Li Haofei, Zhou Dawei, Wang Yizhe, Huang Xinyao, etc., co-directed by Qi Xiaohui and Guo Hao, and produced by Yu Zheng. It was broadcast on Mango TV on July 22, 2020.

"Please Give Me A Pair of Wings" is a Chinese drama set in the early Republic of China, released in 2019. It stars Ju Jingyi, Aaron Yan, Mi Re, Han Dong, and Zhang Yuxi, and premiered on Youku, iQIYI, and Tencent Video on July 9, 2019.
